title: Senior Associate – U.S. Operations
description:
Senior Associate – U.S. Operations

Company: Karia Companies

Office Location: Naroda, Ahmedabad – Work from Office

Employment Type: Full-Time

*About the Role:*

Karia Companies is looking for a Senior Associate – U.S. Operations to join our team in Naroda,

Ahmedabad.

This is a hands-on and client-facing role for someone with experience in U.S. accounting and bookkeeping.

The candidate will be responsible for handling day-to-day accounting activities, understanding the overall

accounting process for assigned clients, coordinating with internal team members, and communicating

directly with U.S.-based clients.

A key part of this role will be participating in and eventually independently leading client meetings,

understanding client requirements, discussing ongoing work and issues, and ensuring proper

follow-through with the internal team.

Key Responsibilities

• Handle day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for U.S.-based clients.

• Work across Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), bank and credit

card reconciliations, and month-end activities.

• Develop a thorough understanding of each client's accounting processes, workflows, and requirements.

• Review accounting transactions and identify errors, discrepancies, or missing information.

• Coordinate with internal team members to ensure work is completed accurately and on time.

• Communicate directly with U.S.-based clients through email and virtual meetings.

• Participate in and lead regular client meetings to discuss ongoing work, pending items, issues, and

priorities.

• Understand client queries and requirements and coordinate with the team for timely resolution.

• Assist with month-end close, reporting, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.

• Take ownership of assigned client accounts and ensure deadlines and deliverables are met.

• Maintain proper documentation and follow client-specific SOPs and accounting procedures.

Candidate Requirements

• 2–4 years of relevant accounting/bookkeeping experience, preferably working with U.S.-based

clients.

• Strong understanding of AP, AR, General Ledger, bank reconciliations, and month-end accounting.

• Good written and spoken English with strong communication skills.

• Confidence and professionalism when communicating directly with U.S.-based clients.

• Ability to understand accounting issues and work toward their resolution.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• Experience with accounting software or ERP systems such as QuickBooks, Famous, NetSuite, Sage,

Xero, or similar platforms is preferred.

• Strong attention to detail, accountability, and ownership of assigned responsibilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can go beyond simply processing accounting transactions.

The ideal candidate should be able to understand the overall accounting process, take ownership of

client work, identify and resolve issues, coordinate effectively with the internal team, and

communicate confidently with U.S.-based clients.

The candidate should be comfortable representing Karia Companies in client meetings and gradually

taking independent ownership of day-to-day client communication and operations.

Work Location & Availability

This is a Work from Office position based in Naroda, Ahmedabad.

The candidate should be flexible to attend scheduled meetings with U.S.-based clients as required.

title: GCC Regional Accountant
description:
Job Location: Ahmedabad, India (supporting UAE, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain)

Tech First Gulf is a value-added IT distributor across the Middle East and Africa, connecting 35+ technology vendors with 6,500+ channel partners in 14+ countries through 18+ offices and a team of 200+. Its portfolio spans cybersecurity, enterprise IT infrastructure, volume solutions, unified communications, audio-visual and extra-low-voltage. · GL entries, accruals, prepayments, fixed asset register, inventory and inter-company

Requirements

Based in India, with working hours flexed to overlap with the UAE, and extended hours around month-end and tax filing deadlines.

title: Deputy Manager - Contract Admin
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

: Adani Buildcast is revolutionizing the construction ecosystem by bringing speed, precision, and sustainability to infrastructure development. Through advanced precast technologies, integrated design solutions, and stringent quality standards, we are redefining how India builds. Our goal is to deliver high-performance structures that combine engineering excellence with environmental responsibility—enhancing productivity, reducing timelines, and ensuring long-term durability. Adani Precast stands at the forefront of industrialized construction, shaping the future of modern infrastructure.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Contract Admininstration Executive is responsible for managing the end-to-end customer invoicing process, drafting, reviewing, tracking, and maintaining contract-related documentation, vendor coordination, ensuring accurate data collection, timely invoice generation, tax compliance, and effective customer management. This role focuses on resolving billing disputes, maintaining documentation, enhancing systems, and supporting revenue reconciliation and audits while aligning with organizational goals and port industry standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Data Collection and Processing:**
Gather operational data from systems, departments to process invoices accurately & raise invoices based on tariff agreements and predefined service-level agreements.
  
  
System Management Operate, manage invoicing activities using SAP systems & contribute to system design and development, including creating Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), conducting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and enhancing existing systems for better functionality.
  
  
**Contract Management**
Assist in preparing, reviewing, and maintaining records of contractual documents including work orders, agreements, and amendments. Ensure all documentation is complete, compliant with internal policies, and legally sound.
  
  
**Vendor Management**
Facilitate day-to-day coordination with vendors for deliverables, invoices, and timelines. Track vendor performance against contractual obligations and escalate deviations.
  
  
**Documentation And Reporting**
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of invoicing details in SAP, other relevant systems & prepare regular Management Information System (MIS) reports for leadership review. Maintain trackers for all ongoing contracts including key dates, terms, and performance metrics. Prepare monthly MIS reports for cash flow visibility and contract performance analytics.
  
  
**Customer Management**
Act as the point of contact for customers regarding invoicing queries related to services, create customer codes, manage KYC documents, and update customer master data & map agreements to ensure accurate billing and efficient service delivery. Support the procurement team in contract execution, free-issue material visualization, and terms finalization. Process and validate vendor invoices based on milestones and delivery confirmation.
  
  
**Issue Resolution**
Address and resolve billing disputes by coordinating with finance, operations, customer service teams & ensure timely resolution of all customer-related issues.
  
  
**Tax Compliance And Controls**
Ensure adherence to tax compliance requirements, internal checks, controls during invoicing processes & mitigate financial risks by upholding organizational policies and statutory regulations. Liaise with legal, finance, procurement, and operations teams to ensure contracts meet project and compliance needs. Act as a communication bridge between cross-functional teams for smooth execution of contract-related tasks.
  
  
**Revenue Reconciliation**
Perform revenue reconciliations to ensure accurate recording and reporting of invoiced amounts.
  
  
**Internal And Statutory Audits**
Provide necessary documentation and support during internal and statutory audits.
  
  
Address auditor queries and ensure compliance with applicable regulations. Identify early warning signs related to contract disputes or delays and assist in mitigation strategies. Ensure adherence to compliance and support documentation for any dispute resolution.
  
  
**Collections And Certificates**
Oversee the collection of charges and issuance of No Dues Certificates (NDC) to customers.
  
  
**System Design And Development**
Lead the creation of Business Requirement Documents (BRD) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system enhancements and development & ensure robust design and functionality to streamline invoice processing systems.
  
  
**Digital Mindset**
Champions a digital mindset within the organization to drive innovation and competitiveness. Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Lead - Customer Invoicing
  
  
Departments, ABEX, Internal auditors, taxation, IT, Marketing, BD, Customer service, Factory Head, Head - Contrat Adminstration , Planning team , Operations team , Finance and accounts team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Customers

**Educational Qualification:**
**BE/B.Tech**
**Work Experience**
6 - 12 years of experience in relevent field

title: Senior Principal Consultant – TSU Manager (Team Leader)
description:
SkyQuest is seeking a senior programme leader to manage a 24-month technical assistance programme supporting a national agricultural development finance institution in Nigeria. The programme aims to strengthen the Institution’s ability to mobilise and deploy capital to agricultural enterprises and organisations serving smallholder farmers, particularly women and underserved producers.

About the role

The TSU Manager will lead a multidisciplinary Technical Support Unit (TSU) and act as the central integration point between the Institution’s CEO and executive management, the funding partner and specialist teams. The role is accountable for programme governance, strategic coherence, executive and Board engagement, delivery oversight and the quality of programme deliverables.

Key responsibilities

* Lead programme governance, integrated planning, decision-making, escalation, risk and issue management, and formal phase-gate reviews.
* Manage a multidisciplinary team of specialist leads; set accountabilities, allocate work, monitor delivery and review all deliverables before submission.
* Serve as the principal counterpart to the Institution’s CEO and executive management and the primary point of contact for the funding partner.
* Lead executive validation sessions, strategic reviews and Board presentations, subject to CEO approval.
* Direct the institutional diagnostic, maturity assessment, prioritisation process and development of a resourced implementation plan.
* Integrate specialist work across agricultural finance and credit risk, technology and data, agribusiness investment readiness, blended-finance capital mobilisation and climate finance.
* Oversee design and testing of a multi-source financing facility, including capital structure, blended-capital architecture, financing documentation and mobilisation strategy.
* Ensure pilots are evidence-based, evaluated and refined, with clear benefits for organisations serving smallholder farmers.
* Lead programme performance management, monitoring, evaluation and learning (MEL), quarterly reviews and the formal mid-term review.
* Oversee institutionalisation, capability transfer and handover of validated policies, tools, models, SOPs and operating arrangements to named Institution owners.

Qualifications and experience

**Education:**
Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Agricultural Economics, Development Studies, Business Administration or a related field. CFA, ACCA, ICAN, PMP/PRINCE2 or equivalent is an advantage.

· 16+ years in development finance, agricultural finance, financial-institution advisory or large technical assistance programmes.

·       Substantial hands-on experience in agricultural lending and agri-finance, including credit appraisal, risk assessment and portfolio management.

· At least 8 years leading multidisciplinary teams on complex, multi-stakeholder programmes as Team Leader, Programme Director or equivalent.

· Experience advising CEOs, executive committees and Boards of banks, DFIs or public financial institutions.

· Track record leading assignments for development partners such as the World Bank Group, AfDB, FCDO, major philanthropic foundations or similar.

· Proven delivery of institutional transformation programmes that were successfully handed over to the client institution.

· Strong programme governance, integrated planning, dependency and risk management, and results-based management skills.

· Sound understanding of DFI operating models and blended-finance instruments.

**Desirable:**
Experience with Nigerian or Sub-Saharan African DFIs; facility or fund design; investor or lender engagement; MEL; gender-inclusive finance; and smallholder-focused impact measurement. Hausa, Yoruba or Igbo is an advantage.

title: Mid-Senior and Senior level US Tax Associates
description:

title: Finance Manager
description:
**COMPANY & BRAND OVERVIEW**

Apas Cosmotech Private Limited is an investor-backed beauty and personal care company. Products are formulated with marine botanical science and manufactured at state-of-the-art, GMP-certified, ISO 22716-compliant OEM facilities, imported via Mundra Port Hub, and distributed pan-India across D2C, major marketplaces (Amazon, Nykaa), and offline retail channels, alongside global export plans. 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Finance Manager is the financial custodian of Cincinnus across every channel the brand sells through: the D2C website, Amazon, Nykaa and other approved marketplaces, and offline retail. Reporting directly to the CBGO, this role owns accurate books, channel-wise profitability, cash and working capital, import and inventory costing, tax and statutory compliance, and investor-grade reporting. 

In a D2C and retail business, revenue is earned in one place and cash lands in another, so a core part of this role is reconciling every order to the money actually received: payment gateway and COD settlements, marketplace payouts net of commissions and fees, returns, RTOs, and distributor claims. Brand, content and paid performance marketing decisions sit with the growth team; this role provides the budgets, unit economics and spend controls those decisions run on. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Financial Reporting & Month-End Close**

- Own the monthly, quarterly and annual close, delivering accurate books within [5] working days of month-end. - Prepare P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and monthly MIS, with clear variance commentary for leadership. - Ensure correct revenue recognition across channels, including sales returns, RTO reversals, discounts, coupons and marketplace-funded promotions. 

- Prepare financial statements in line with Ind AS / applicable accounting standards and Companies Act requirements. 

**Channel P&L & Unit Economics**

- Build and maintain channel-wise P&Ls for D2C, Amazon, Nykaa, other marketplaces and offline retail. - Track SKU- and order-level unit economics: gross margin, landed COGS, marketplace commissions and fees, shipping and packaging cost, payment gateway charges, return and RTO cost, and contribution margin. - Partner with the growth team to monitor marketing spend against revenue, including CAC, ROAS, payback period and repeat-purchase contribution. 

- Evaluate the margin impact of pricing, bundles, discovery kits, sale events (e.g., Prime Day, Nykaa Pink Friday) and free-shipping thresholds before they go live. 

- Support MRP setting, trade margins and price-harmony guardrails so pricing stays consistent and profitable across channels.

**D2C & Marketplace Reconciliation**

- Reconcile D2C orders from the Shopify / D2C platform against payment gateway settlements and COD remittances from logistics partners. 

- Reconcile Amazon and Nykaa settlement reports order by order: commissions, fulfilment and storage fees, advertising deductions, TCS, returns, and reimbursements. 

- Raise and track claims for lost, damaged or wrongly charged inventory and fees with marketplaces and courier partners. 

- Monitor returns, RTO rates and refund accuracy, and flag leakages to the operations and growth teams.

**Offline Retail & Distributor Finance**

- Set up and manage commercial terms for distributors, modern trade chains and retail partners, including margins, credit limits and payment terms. 

- Manage trade schemes, promotional claims, display and listing fees, and their settlement. - Track trade receivables, follow up on overdue payments and maintain healthy receivable days. - Reconcile stock and ledger balances with distributors and retail partners on a regular basis.
**Inventory, Imports & Costing**

- Compute accurate landed cost for OEM imports through Mundra Port, covering FOB value, freight, insurance, customs duty, IGST, clearing and inland transport. 

- Manage import payments, forex exposure and documentation with banks and the CHA, in line with FEMA requirements. 

- Maintain inventory valuation across own warehouses, 3PL partners, marketplace fulfilment centres (e.g., FBA) and distributor stock. 

- Run periodic stock reconciliations and track shelf life, near-expiry and damaged stock, with timely provisions and write-offs. 

- Track inventory days and working capital tied up in stock, and support purchase planning with cash-flow inputs.

**Tax & Statutory Compliance**

- Ensure timely GST compliance across all registrations, including multi-state warehouse registrations, e-invoicing, e-way bills and GSTR filings. 

- Reconcile marketplace TCS and TDS credits, and manage input tax credit on imports, packaging, services and marketing. 

- Manage TDS on payments to vendors, agencies, creators and influencers, along with income tax, advance tax and ROC / MCA filings. 

- Coordinate statutory, internal and tax audits, and close audit observations on time. 

**Budgeting, Forecasting & Investor Reporting**

- Lead the annual budget and monthly rolling forecasts by channel, covering revenue, gross margin, marketing spend, overheads and cash. 

- Track burn rate, cash runway and progress against the business plan agreed with investors. - Prepare monthly investor MIS and board packs, and support fundraising, due diligence and data-room preparation. 

- Build financial models for new SKU launches, new channels, quick-commerce expansion, export markets and capex decisions. 

**Treasury, Working Capital & Controls**

- Manage daily cash flow, banking relationships, working capital facilities and fund deployment. - Process vendor payments to OEMs, packaging suppliers, logistics partners, agencies and creators within the approval matrix.

- Design and enforce internal controls, delegation of authority and spend controls, including marketing and influencer payouts. 

- Own the accounting system (e.g., Tally / Zoho Books / ERP) and drive automation of integrations with Shopify, marketplaces, payment gateways and logistics platforms. 

- Lead, train and review the work of the accounts team and external consultants. 

**Tracking & Executive Reporting**

- Prepare weekly and monthly finance dashboards covering GMV vs net revenue, channel contribution margin, marketing spend efficiency, cash position, receivables, payables and inventory days. 

- Flag margin leakages, cost overruns and cash risks early, with clear recommendations.

**CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS & PROFILE**

- Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred; CMA or MBA (Finance) with strong hands-on accounting experience will be considered. 

- Experience: Approximately 6–8 years in finance and accounts, including at least 2 years managing month-end close, compliance and a small team. 

- Industry Focus: Prior experience in a D2C brand, Beauty, Personal Care, Cosmetics or FMCG company is strongly preferred; exposure to an investor-backed or startup environment is a plus. 

- Channel Knowledge: Hands-on experience reconciling Shopify / D2C orders, payment gateway and COD settlements, and Amazon Seller Central and Nykaa settlement reports. 

- Trade & Imports: Working knowledge of distributor and modern trade finance, and of import costing, customs duty and GST on imports. 

- Systems & Tools: Proficiency in Tally / Zoho Books / ERP and advanced Excel (financial modelling, pivots, lookups); familiarity with BI dashboards is a plus. 

- Communication: Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain numbers to founders, the growth team and investors. 

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

Financial custodianship | Channel P&L and unit economics | Reconciliation discipline | Tax and statutory compliance | Cash and working capital management | Commercial judgement | Cross-functional collaboration | Ownership and attention to detail | Integrity and confidentiality 

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

- Timeliness and accuracy of month-end close, monthly MIS and investor reporting. 

- Accuracy of channel-wise P&L and SKU-level contribution margin across D2C, Amazon, Nykaa and offline retail. 

- Reconciliation completeness for payment gateway, COD and marketplace settlements, and value of claims recovered. 

- Receivable days for distributors and retail partners, and payable discipline with vendors. - Accuracy of landed costing, inventory valuation and stock reconciliations, and control of near-expiry write-offs. - On-time GST, TDS, income tax and ROC filings, with zero penalties and clean audit outcomes. - Budget vs actual variance, forecast accuracy, and visibility of cash runway. 

- Strength of internal controls and spend approvals, including marketing and influencer payouts.

- Accuracy and timeliness of weekly and monthly finance dashboards for leadership.

title: Controls Senior Analyst / Specialist
description:
Job Description :

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Controls Senior Analyst / Specialist**
to support the design, documentation, assessment, and testing of financial processes and internal controls. The role will focus on Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR), Risk and Control Matrices (RACMs), financial process walkthroughs, control testing, and control gap assessments.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Internal Controls Manager to facilitate process walkthroughs, document risks and controls, evaluate control effectiveness, and coordinate control campaigns and reporting activities. The role will also contribute to developing AI-enabled risk and controls capabilities, including AI agents and automation for control testing and RACM creation.

**Key Responsibilities**

Financial Process Walkthroughs & Documentation

* Co-facilitate financial process walkthroughs with the Internal Controls Manager.
* Engage with relevant stakeholders to understand financial processes, identify risks, and document existing controls.
* Prepare process flowcharts, narratives, and supporting documentation.
* Identify key financial reporting risks and assess the adequacy of existing controls.
* Ensure process documentation is accurate, complete, and aligned with internal control requirements.

Risk & Control Matrices (RACMs)

* Prepare and maintain Risk and Control Matrices (RACMs) for relevant financial processes.
* Identify and document process risks, control objectives, control activities, control owners, and testing requirements.
* Assess the design and adequacy of controls in mitigating identified risks.
* Update RACMs based on process changes, control gaps, risk assessments, and stakeholder feedback.
* Maintain consistent documentation standards across controls and financial processes.

Controls Testing & Gap Assessments

* Perform controls testing to assess the design and operating effectiveness of internal controls.
* Gather and review supporting evidence to validate control performance.
* Identify control deficiencies, gaps, and potential weaknesses in financial processes.
* Document testing results, observations, and supporting analysis.
* Support the development and tracking of corrective actions to address identified control gaps.
* Escalate significant control deficiencies and testing issues to the Internal Controls Manager.

ICFR, UK Provision 29 & SOX

* Support Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR) activities and related control frameworks.
* Assist with controls documentation and assessment aligned with applicable UK financial reporting governance requirements, including Provision 29 of the UK Corporate Governance Code, where applicable.
* Support Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control activities for relevant US reporting requirements, where applicable.
* Help maintain evidence, testing documentation, and reporting required for internal controls assessments.
* Monitor control compliance and support improvements in the overall control environment.

Controls Team Administration & Project Coordination

* Coordinate financial process walkthrough schedules, stakeholder meetings, and project plans.
* Maintain project trackers, control calendars, and documentation repositories.
* Monitor progress against agreed milestones and deliverables.
* Coordinate control campaigns and track completion status.
* Prepare status reports, identify delays, and escalate outstanding issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support effective communication across the controls team and business functions.

Risk Assessments & Management Reporting

* Perform controls risk assessments as required.
* Analyze identified risks and evaluate the effectiveness of existing mitigation measures.
* Prepare control status reports, gap analysis summaries, and management updates.
* Track remediation activities and follow up with control owners on outstanding actions.
* Provide clear documentation of findings, risks, and recommendations.

AI, Automation & Controls Innovation

* Support the development of AI-enabled risk and controls capabilities.
* Contribute to building AI agents to support controls documentation, risk analysis, and testing activities.
* Explore automation opportunities for RACM creation, evidence review, and controls testing.
* Collaborate with relevant teams to streamline manual control processes and improve efficiency.
* Assist in documenting, testing, and refining AI-enabled workflows for risk and internal controls activities.

**Qualifications**

* Qualified Accountant with ACCA or ACA qualification,
  **or**
  a relevant Risk Management / Internal Audit qualification such as CIA.
* Candidates with another relevant professional qualification in accounting, risk, or internal audit may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of financial processes, internal controls, and risk assessment methodologies.
* Knowledge of ICFR, UK Provision 29, or SOX frameworks will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **3–5 years of relevant experience**
  in internal controls, financial process reviews, internal audit, risk assurance, or controls testing.
* Hands-on experience conducting financial process walkthroughs and documenting process flows.
* Practical experience preparing and maintaining Risk and Control Matrices (RACMs).
* Experience performing controls testing, assessing control effectiveness, and documenting control gaps.
* Experience conducting risk assessments and supporting remediation activities.
* Prior experience in Real Estate, Construction, or Property Development is preferred but not mandatory.
* Experience with GRC, Internal Audit, or Risk Management tools will be an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of financial processes and internal control frameworks.
* Practical experience in RACM preparation, controls testing, and control gap assessments.
* Ability to document financial processes, risks, controls, and testing outcomes accurately.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to assess control design and operating effectiveness.
* Good project coordination and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation quality.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, deadlines, and control activities.
* Interest in AI-enabled controls, process automation, and risk technology.

**Technical Skills**

* **Microsoft Visio:**
  Advanced proficiency for process mapping and flowchart preparation.
* **GRC / Internal Audit / Risk Tools:**
  Experience preferred but not mandatory.
* **AI & Automation:**
  Exposure to AI agents, workflow automation, or automated controls testing will be an advantage.

**Communication Skills**

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to conduct process walkthroughs and communicate effectively with control owners and stakeholders.
* Strong documentation and report-writing skills.
* Ability to explain control gaps, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Confidence in coordinating meetings, tracking actions, and escalating issues professionally.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* A qualified accounting, risk, or internal audit professional with 3–5 years of relevant controls experience.
* Hands-on experience with financial process walkthroughs, RACMs, controls testing, and control gap assessments.
* Strong Microsoft Visio skills and the ability to develop clear, accurate process flowcharts.

title: Senior Accounts Executive – E-commerce
description:
**About the opportunity**

Take ownership of day-to-day accounts for YtaminzFashion, a women’s ethnic and fusion wear brand operated by Propsquad Pvt Ltd.

Based on-site in Ahmedabad, this full-time role combines day-to-day bookkeeping with marketplace accounting across Amazon, Myntra, Flipkart and our website. You will maintain accurate accounting records, reconcile settlements and bank receipts, investigate deductions, and follow through on refunds and claims.

This is an opportunity to build experience across the complete transaction cycle-from recording purchases and sales to checking settlements, resolving deductions and recovering pending payments.

**Your responsibilities**

**Bookkeeping and accounting records**

* Maintain accurate sales, purchase, expense, receipt, payment and credit-note records with supporting documents.
* Keep customer, supplier, bank and marketplace ledgers updated.

**Reconciliation and payment recovery**

* Reconcile marketplace settlements, payment-gateway and COD receipts, refunds, fees and courier charges against order reports and bank records.
* Complete bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Investigate missing payments and incorrect deductions; maintain a recovery tracker and follow up until closure.

**Returns, refunds and claims**

* Track returns, exchanges and RTO cases using receipt and product-status updates from the operations team.
* Submit approved SAFE-T and other shipment/return claims with supporting evidence.
* Track submission and response deadlines, escalate delayed or rejected cases, and reconcile recoveries.

**Marketplace and system support**

* Raise and follow up on tickets for escalated shipment, tracking, order-sync, invoice, label and return-system issues.
* Coordinate with marketplaces, couriers and relevant platforms, including Shopify, Unicommerce and Return Prime.
* Maintain clear case records and verify that issues are resolved.

**Purchase documentation and packaging**

* Prepare purchase orders as instructed for approved purchases.
* Check supplier bills against approved orders and goods-receipt records; flag discrepancies before payment.
* Monitor packaging consumables, raise replenishment requirements and coordinate approved purchases.

**Monthly reporting**

* Organise invoices, credit notes and channel tax reports.
* Prepare reconciliation summaries, supporting schedules for tax reporting and checked data for profitability reporting.
* Update existing trackers and report outstanding balances, recoveries and unresolved issues to management.

**What we are looking for**

* At least 2 years of practical bookkeeping and account reconciliation experience is required.
* At least 1 year of hands-on Tally experience is required, including vouchers, ledgers, credit notes and bank reconciliation.
* At least 1 year of working experience with Microsoft Excel is required, including matching records and investigating differences. Lookup formulas and PivotTables are an advantage.
* E-commerce settlement, returns or claims experience is preferred. Familiarity with our platforms is helpful; experience with every platform is not required.
* Attention to detail, ownership and consistent follow-up.
* Ability to write clear support emails in English and communicate in Hindi or Gujarati.

Full-time

Job Description – AGM / DGM – Purchase (Capex & Opex Management)

**Department:**
Purchase / Procurement

**Designation:**
Assistant General Manager (AGM) / Deputy General Manager (DGM) – Purchase

**Industry:**
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

**Plant Exposure:**
Formulation, API, and Injectables

Job Purpose

To lead and drive strategic procurement activities for Capital Expenditure (Capex) and Operational Expenditure (Opex) across Formulation, API, and Injectables manufacturing plants. The role will focus on strategic sourcing, vendor development, commercial negotiations, cost optimization, budget control, and timely procurement of equipment, engineering materials, spares, utilities, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Capex Procurement

* Lead end-to-end procurement of capital equipment, plant machinery, engineering systems, utilities, and infrastructure for Formulation, API, and Injectables facilities.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Projects, Production, QA, QC, and Finance teams to finalize technical specifications and procurement requirements.
* Evaluate technical and commercial offers, conduct techno-commercial comparisons, and negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and contractual conditions.
* Manage procurement for new projects, plant expansions, capacity enhancements, and facility modernization.
* Ensure timely procurement within approved budgets and project timelines.

2. Opex Procurement

* Manage procurement of maintenance spares, engineering materials, consumables, utility-related items, services, and other plant operational requirements.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of critical materials to support plant operations and maintenance.
* Monitor Opex expenditure against approved budgets and implement cost-reduction initiatives.
* Optimize inventory levels, procurement lead times, and purchasing costs.
* Establish annual rate contracts and long-term supplier agreements wherever appropriate.

3. Strategic Sourcing & Cost Optimization

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business objectives and annual Capex/Opex budgets.
* Identify alternate suppliers, indigenous sourcing opportunities, and value-engineering initiatives.
* Drive cost savings through competitive bidding, negotiations, supplier consolidation, and long-term contracts.
* Monitor market trends, pricing benchmarks, and procurement performance indicators.
* Prepare periodic cost-saving reports and procurement performance dashboards.

4. Vendor Development & Management

* Identify, evaluate, develop, and manage suppliers for pharmaceutical equipment, engineering materials, utilities, spares, and technical services.
* Conduct supplier evaluations in coordination with Engineering, QA, and other relevant departments.
* Establish strong vendor relationships and resolve issues related to cost, quality, delivery, and contractual commitments.
* Ensure compliance with vendor qualification and documentation requirements.

5. Compliance & Procurement Governance

* Ensure adherence to procurement policies, approval matrices, financial controls, and ethical purchasing practices.
* Maintain proper documentation of quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders, contracts, and supplier evaluations.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to meet applicable pharmaceutical quality, EHS, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure transparency, accountability, and audit readiness across procurement activities.

6. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Lead and mentor the purchase team, establish performance objectives, and drive continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Projects, Plant Operations, Finance, QA, QC, Stores, and Supply Chain teams.
* Review procurement budgets, expenditure trends, supplier performance, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Present procurement strategies, project updates, and performance reports to senior management.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in pharmaceutical purchase and procurement, with substantial exposure to both Capex and Opex.
* Experience working with Formulation, API, and Injectables manufacturing plants.
* Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical machinery, engineering equipment, plant utilities, MRO spares, consumables, and technical services procurement.
* Proven expertise in strategic sourcing, techno-commercial evaluation, vendor development, contract negotiation, and cost optimization.
* Working knowledge of ERP/SAP procurement processes and purchasing documentation.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

An experienced pharmaceutical procurement professional capable of independently managing strategic Capex and Opex purchasing across Formulation, API, and Injectables facilities, driving cost savings, developing a robust supplier base, and ensuring timely procurement in line with business and operational requirements.

title: Senior Manager Project Finance
description:
**Support the end-to-end project financing lifecycle for greenfield, brownfield, acquisition, expansion and refinancing projects across Adani Group businesses. The role involves financial modelling, lender coordination, debt syndication support, documentation review, financial closure management, loan drawdowns, covenant compliance and stakeholder management to ensure timely availability of funds and optimal capital structure.**

**Educational Qualification:**

**CA / MBA (Finance) / ICWA / Inter CA / CFA or equivalent in Financial Management.**

**Experience: 12-18 years of project finance experience and at least 3-5 successful financial closures across greenfield or expansion projects.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Evaluation & Financial Analysis**

* Review project business plans, DPRs, capex estimates and funding requirements.
* Analyze project viability, profitability, DSCR, IRR, Project IRR, Equity IRR and key risk indicators.
* Develop and maintain detailed project financial models.
* Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis for project risks.
* Support project appraisal presentations for management and lenders.
* Evaluate financing alternatives and recommend optimal debt-equity structures.

**2. Debt Raising & Financial Closure**

* Prepare lender presentations, teasers and information memorandums.
* Coordinate with banks, financial institutions and credit funds.
* Assist in debt syndication and lender onboarding activities.
* Support negotiations on financing terms and commercial conditions.
* Track sanction approvals and financial closure milestones.
* Ensure timely fulfillment of sanction conditions.

**3. Financial Modelling**

* Build project finance models from scratch.
* Update base case and lender models.
* Incorporate debt sizing, drawdowns, moratoriums and repayment schedules.
* Validate assumptions received from business and consultants.
* Support refinancing and restructuring analysis.

**4. Due Diligence & Lender Coordination**

* Coordinate with lenders, consultants, technical advisors and legal teams.
* Manage TEV, legal, insurance, environmental and traffic studies.
* Track diligence observations and closures.
* Facilitate lender site visits and management meetings.

**5. Documentation & Security Creation**

* Review sanction letters and term sheets.
* Coordinate execution of facility agreements and security documents.
* Work with legal counsel on financing documentation.
* Ensure timely security creation and charge registration.
* Support satisfaction of precedent conditions.

**6. Loan Disbursement & Drawdown Management**

* Coordinate drawdown requests with lenders.
* Verify utilization certificates and supporting documents.
* Track debt utilization against approved project costs.
* Ensure timely fund availability for project execution.

**7. Covenant Monitoring & Compliance**

* Monitor financial and non-financial covenants.
* Track DSRA, escrow, security cover and reporting obligations.
* Submit periodic information to lenders.
* Maintain covenant compliance dashboards.

**8. Refinancing & Capital Structure Optimization**

* Monitor interest rate trends and refinancing opportunities.
* Prepare refinancing business cases.
* Support bond issuance, NCDs, ECBs and structured financing transactions.
* Evaluate opportunities to reduce financing costs.

**9. MIS & Reporting**

* Maintain project financing MIS and debt trackers.
* Prepare management updates for CFO, CEO and Treasury Head.
* Track debt pipeline, closure status and lender exposure.
* Support board and committee presentations.

**Prospects from a Infrastructure / Manufacturing / Finance Industry with extensive experience In Project Finance can connect at joy.saha@adani.com OR 9898791075**

title: Credit Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**

The Credit Analyst will be responsible for end-to-end credit assessment of dairy and cattle loan applications. The role includes borrower and co-borrower assessment, bureau analysis, dairy cash-flow evaluation, review of field/PD findings, verification of cattle and vendor details, and timely credit decisioning in accordance with approved lender and internal credit policies.

**Key Responsibilities**

·  Underwrite dairy/cattle loan applications and recommend approval, rejection, or escalation as per defined credit policy and authority matrix.

·  Analyse borrower and co-borrower bureau reports, including repayment history, active loans, overdue accounts, enquiries and overall indebtedness.

·  Assess dairy income based on number and type of cattle, breed, milk yield, milk selling price, dairy/co-operative receipts and operating expenses.

·  Assess household income, agricultural income and other supplementary income to determine overall repayment capacity.

·  Calculate FOIR, household cash surplus and proposed EMI affordability.

·  Review KYC, bank statements, milk-payment records, income proofs, and other documents submitted with the loan application.

·  Review Personal Discussion (PD), field verification, and residence/business verification findings and identify inconsistencies or adverse observations.

·  Conduct telephonic or video customer verification/PD wherever required.

·  Validate proposed cattle purchase, cattle valuation, supplier/vendor details, insurance, and RFID/tagging information wherever applicable.

·  Identify potential fraud and credit risks including multiple borrowing, over-financing, inflated cattle valuation, weak cash flows, adverse bureau behaviour, document mismatch and customer/vendor collusion.

·  Raise clear credit queries and coordinate with Sales/Operations teams for required clarifications or additional documents.

·  Ensure compliance with lender-specific credit policies, deviation rules, approval conditions, and documentation requirements.

·  Maintain defined credit TAT and daily productivity while ensuring underwriting quality.

·  Maintain accurate credit notes, assessment rationale, and approval/rejection remarks in the system.

·  Review early delinquency, FPD/SPD and bounce cases assigned for credit feedback and identify underwriting gaps.

·  Support credit audits, lender reviews and policy back-testing by providing case-level information and observations.

**Candidate Profile**

·  Graduate/Postgraduate in Finance, Commerce, Agriculture, Rural Management or a related discipline.

·  1–4 years of experience in credit underwriting, preferably in Dairy Loans, Cattle Loans, Agri Loans, Rural Finance, Microfinance, MSME, or retail lending.

·  Candidates with hands-on experience in rural borrower assessment and informal income evaluation will be preferred.

**Required Skills:**

·  Strong understanding of credit underwriting and borrower risk assessment.

·  Good knowledge of CIBIL / Experian / CRIF / Equifax bureau reports.

·  Ability to assess rural and informal household cash flows.

·  Understanding of FOIR, EMI affordability, banking analysis, and existing obligations.

·  Understanding of dairy economics, milk-income assessment and cattle valuation will be an advantage.

·  Strong analytical skills with ability to identify fraud indicators and data/document inconsistencies.

·  Good working knowledge of Excel and credit MIS.

·  Ability to handle high case volumes and work within strict TAT.

·  Good communication and customer-interaction skills.

·  Working knowledge of Hindi; Gujarati/Rajasthani or other relevant regional languages will be an advantage.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

·  Credit TAT

·  Number of cases processed / productivity

·  Quality and accuracy of underwriting decisions

·  FPD / SPD and early delinquency performance of approved cases

·  Bounce and portfolio-quality trends

·  Policy and documentation compliance

·  Credit-query quality and resolution time

·  Audit and quality-control observations

title: Articled Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
MRUNAL M. SHAH AND CO. is a professional firm based in Ahmedabad, offering audit, taxation, accounting, and advisory services to a diverse portfolio of clients. The firm focuses on delivering accurate, compliant, and timely financial solutions that support effective business decision-making. Team members gain hands-on exposure to practical aspects of accounting and finance, along with opportunities to learn directly from experienced professionals. The working environment encourages ethical conduct, continuous learning, and professional growth for aspiring chartered accountants.

The Articled Assistant will support audit assignments, including vouching, verification of documents, preparation of working papers, and assistance in statutory and tax audits. Daily responsibilities include maintaining books of accounts, preparing financial statements, and assisting with tax computations, return filings, and compliance documentation. * Candidate should possess clear written and verbal communication skills, along with a professional and ethical approach to client interactions.
* Enrollment as an articled trainee under ICAI (or eligibility to register) and ongoing pursuit of CA qualification will be considered highly beneficial.
* Ability to work in a hybrid setup from Ahmedabad, maintain confidentiality, and collaborate effectively with team members.

title: Manager - Regulatory & Commercial
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Manager - Regulatory & Commercial (ERCG)**
**Billing And Revenue Management**
Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.
  
  
Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers
  
  
Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.
  
  
Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.
  
  
Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.
  
  
Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.
  
  
**Payment Tracking And Dispute Resolution**
Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.
  
  
In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.
  
  
Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.
  
  
Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.
  
  
Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.
  
  
**Portal Management**
Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.
  
  
Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.
  
  
Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.
  
  
Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.
  
  
Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.
  
  
**Financial Reporting And Reconciliation**
Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.
  
  
Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.
  
  
Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.
  
  
**Regulatory Support And Tariff Management**
Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.
  
  
Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.
  
  
In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.
  
  
**Preferred Industry**
Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

Withum's Forensic and Valuation Services practice pride themselves in understanding their clients’ business strategy and needs; assisting companies in meeting business requirements related to valuation, risk management, transfer pricing, economic analysis, and model validation. Withum professionals help clients make forward thinking decisions about strategy, operations and compliance and create long-lasting value.

We are currently seeking a Manager to join Withum’s Forensic and Valuation Services Group.

The Manager will work on a variety of assignments, including taking substantial responsibility of overseeing and performing equity valuations or complex security valuations (stock options, warrants, convertible debt, other complex securities/derivatives, etc.) for financial reporting, tax compliance, transaction advisory, and other purposes. The engagements will be performed for mostly medium-sized businesses to large multinational corporations. The Manager should demonstrate the ability to provide excellent client service and assist the growth of team members in developing technical skills and professional competency.

Withum’s brand is a reflection of our people, our culture and our strength. Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive - to be in a position of strength. But our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.

The role would focus on supporting engagements involving
**complex capital structures, option pricing, and fair value assessments**
, particularly in financial reporting and transaction‑related assignments.

**How You’ll Spend Your Time:**

* Overseeing valuation analyses for tax, financial reporting, and advisory purposes (enterprise values, stock options, warrants, convertible debt, equity allocations across complex capital structures, and other complex securities/derivatives) primarily in Excel
* Implementing and improving processes in performing valuations and writing and preparing of reports, letters, and other client deliverables
* Assisting in review of third party appraisals for audit support purposes.
* Assisting in the development, maintenance, application of models using Excel and VBA for Monte Carlo, lattices, or other complex methods as requested
* Reviewing and gaining a sufficient understanding of the necessary tax and financial reporting guidance governing the analysis

**Requirements:**

* Qualification: Commerce Graduate/Postgraduate
* Experience: 7 -10 years in business valuations in CFI & 409A is required
* In-depth understanding of valuation methods such as discounted cash flow, market multiple, market transaction, and option pricing
* Experience in valuation of complex financial instruments is strongly preferred
* Valuation related certification including ASA, CVA, ABV, CEIV, or CFA
* Advanced knowledge of Excel and Capital IQ preferred
* Ability to program in VBA and/or other statistical package a plus
* Capacity to work independently on projects
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, as well as strong verbal and written communication skills

* Six Plus years of relevant experience, with

  .

Interested candidates may send their CV, a brief note on relevant experience and current remuneration to

title: Junior Accountant
description:
**Location:**
Makarba, Ahmedabad

**Work Arrangement:**
Full-time, On-site

**Employment Type:**
Permanent

**Experience:**
1–2 years

**Compensation:**
Competitive, commensurate with experience

**About Our Client**

Our client is an established sustainable logistics and supply chain optimization company headquartered in Mumbai, with a regional office in Ahmedabad. Founded in 2019, the company operates a technology-driven container reuse platform that helps cargo owners, freight forwarders, and shipping lines reduce empty container trips, lower freight costs, and cut carbon emissions. They partner with major global shipping companies and have raised over $4.5 million in funding from prominent investors. The Ahmedabad office serves as a key operational hub for the company’s growing India operations.

**About the Role**

This is a hands-on accounting role suited to an early-career professional who has foundational knowledge of Indian accounting practices and statutory compliance. You will support the finance team in maintaining accurate financial records, processing day-to-day transactions, and assisting with GST and TDS filings.

In this position, you will work closely with senior accounting staff and coordinate with vendors and internal teams to ensure timely and accurate financial operations. This is an excellent opportunity for a junior accountant looking to build their career in a fast-paced, growth-oriented logistics technology company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Bookkeeping & Records: Maintain day-to-day bookkeeping entries and assist in preparing MIS reports.
* Accounts Payable & Receivable: Monitor accounts receivable and payables to ensure timely settlements.
* GST & TDS Compliance: Assist in compiling data for GST and TDS return filing.
* Payment Processing: Prepare payment sheets aligned with internal payment policies.
* Reconciliations: Assist in periodic ledger scrutiny and bank reconciliations.
* Vendor & Customer Coordination: Coordinate with customers and vendors for documentation and financial requirements.
* Data Management: Maintain accurate financial data in accounting software and spreadsheets.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B.Com) or related field.
* Experience: 1–2 years of hands-on accounting experience.
* Technical Knowledge: Mandatory understanding of GST, TDS, and Indian accounting principles.
* Software Proficiency: Working knowledge of Tally and MS Excel.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills for vendor and internal coordination.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MS Office suite (Word, PowerPoint).
* Exposure to logistics, shipping, or technology industry accounting.
* Pursuing or completed CA Inter / CMA Inter.

**Technical Skills**

Accounting Software: Tally

Statutory Knowledge: GST, TDS, Indian Accounting Standards

Tools: MS Excel (intermediate), MS Office

Core Skills: Bookkeeping, accounts payable/receivable, bank reconciliation, ledger scrutiny

**What You Will Bring**

* A detail-oriented approach to financial record-keeping and data accuracy.
* Foundational knowledge of Indian tax and compliance frameworks (GST, TDS).
* Willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned accounting functions.
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* A collaborative attitude and comfort working in a fast-paced office environment.

**Why This Opportunity**

* Growth Industry: Join a fast-growing logistics technology company backed by marquee investors.
* Learning Environment: Gain hands-on exposure to end-to-end accounting operations including GST and TDS compliance.
* Career Development: Opportunity to grow within a finance team supporting a scaling organization.
* Convenient Location: Office located in Makarba, Ahmedabad, with easy access to major transport routes.

title: Relationship Manager

title: ECommerce and Modern Trade
description:
**Company Description**
Shree Gopal Agri is a leading processor of groundnuts and roasted peanuts, focused on delivering high-quality products to domestic and international markets. The company sources groundnuts directly from farmers, ensuring traceability, freshness, and fair value across the supply chain. Its operations are guided by strong values of pride, honesty, professional ethics, and fair business practices. With locations in Jetpur, Saurashtra, and Ahmedabad, Shree Gopal Agri benefits from access to one of India’s best groundnut-growing regions and a robust distribution network for efficient market reach.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Ahmedabad, focused on ECommerce and Modern Trade for SHREGO. The role involves managing online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms, including product listings, pricing, promotions, and inventory coordination. The individual will build and maintain relationships with modern trade partners, negotiate listings and visibility, and ensure timely execution of promotions and planograms. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring sales performance, analyzing channel data, tracking competitor activity, and coordinating with supply chain and marketing teams to support growth. The role also requires regular reporting on key metrics, implementing channel-specific strategies, and ensuring a consistent brand presence across all modern trade and eCommerce channels.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in ECommerce management and online marketplace operations, including handling product catalogs, pricing, and promotions.
* Skills in modern trade account management, including relationship building, negotiation, and execution of in-store and channel-specific activities.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to work with sales data, channel performance metrics, and market insights.
* Knowledge of FMCG or food/agri products, with an understanding of retail, distribution, and consumer buying behavior.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and other productivity tools; familiarity with ERP or inventory management systems is an advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across sales, marketing, and operations teams.
* Ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad, manage multiple priorities, and maintain high standards of integrity and professionalism.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; prior experience in ECommerce or modern trade channels is preferred.

* Excellent verbal and written English communication.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Previous experience with Power BI to Sigma migration projects.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or other cloud data warehouses.
* Experience with Sigma APIs, automation, and embedding.
* Knowledge of ETL/ELT pipelines and data engineering.
* Experience leading BI modernization or migration initiatives.

Candidate Requirements

* Strong production-level Sigma Computing development experience, preferably 2+ years.
* Proven hands-on Power BI development expertise.
* Ability to independently deliver complex dashboards and reporting solutions.
* Strong client-facing communication skills.

title: Retail commercial pricing analyst (US night shift)
description:
Price Book Analyst

Location: Ahmedabad, India (Remote until Office is Established)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Experience Required: 4–5+ Years

CTC: ₹75,000 – ₹1,00,000 per month

Work Hours: US Shift – Must overlap at least 5 hours with US Eastern Time (approx. 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST, or as agreed)

Reports To: Owner

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Price Book Assistant to manage pricing accuracy across multiple retail stores. The role will focus on maintaining accurate cost and retail pricing, ensuring margins are properly maintained, updating prices when vendor costs change, and preparing regular sales and pricing reports for management.

The ideal candidate should be highly detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers and Excel, and experienced in retail pricing, merchandising, bookkeeping, inventory, or other accuracy-focused roles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Book / Sales Summary Reporting

- Prepare recurring sales summaries for management review.

- Analyze sales performance by item, category, and store.

- Generate and review sales reports using the retail back-office system.

- Compare sales performance across individual stores and the overall business.

- Use sales data to support pricing, purchasing, and inventory decisions.

- Maintain accurate and timely reporting for management.

2. Pricing & Margin Management

- Ensure retail prices accurately reflect current product costs and required margins.

- Review item-level pricing and identify pricing or margin discrepancies.

- Update retail prices whenever vendor costs change.

- Audit margins by item, category, and store.

- Identify products that are underpriced, over-priced, or not meeting the required margin.

- Ensure pricing changes are accurately reflected across the required stores.

3. Excel-Based Price & Cost Updates

- Prepare and manage bulk price and cost changes using Microsoft Excel.

- Review and cross-check pricing data before importing updates into the retail back-office system.

- Perform mass price and cost updates where required.

- Ensure imported pricing data is accurate and meets the required margin structure.

- Maintain proper records of pricing changes and updates.

4. Price Book Accuracy & Maintenance

- Maintain the accuracy of the price book across multiple stores.

- Review item costs, retail prices, margins, and related pricing information regularly.

- Identify and correct discrepancies in pricing and cost data.

- Coordinate with relevant teams/vendors when cost or pricing information needs clarification.

- Ensure pricing information remains consistent and up to date across stores.

Required Qualifications

- 4–5+ years of experience in retail pricing, merchandising, bookkeeping, inventory, purchasing, or a similar detail-oriented, numbers-focused role.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work with repetitive, accuracy-critical data.

- Good understanding of cost, retail price, markup, and margin calculations.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills for reviewing, comparing, and updating pricing data.

- Comfortable working with POS / retail back-office systems.

- Prior experience with ECRS Catapult is an advantage but not mandatory.

- Ability to analyze sales and pricing reports and identify discrepancies.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage large volumes of item and pricing data.

- Willingness to work in a US shift and maintain the required overlap with US Eastern Time.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who is highly detail-oriented and comfortable working with pricing, costs, margins, Excel, and large volumes of retail data. The candidate should be able to identify pricing discrepancies, maintain accurate price books across multiple stores, and provide reliable sales and pricing reports to management.

title: Oracle Fusion Financial Consultant
description:
**About the Company**

Medovate Pvt Ltd is building a Technology and Operations Centre in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, to deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials services for a multi-entity international group operating across the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China, and India. The group runs Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP across multiple legal entities and ledgers, with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) connecting Fusion Financials to banking partners, intercompany systems, and external platforms.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Oracle Fusion Finance Functional Consultant to strengthen the Finance practice at Medovate's Ahmedabad center. This is a hands-on functional delivery role. You will support the configuration and delivery of Oracle Fusion Financials across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets, working under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead and alongside senior consultants. You will contribute to design workshops, execute configuration, prepare functional documentation, and support testing across a multi-entity international environment. This is an opportunity to broaden your Oracle Fusion Financials experience across multiple modules and geographies while building depth in a specialist Finance capability.

**Responsibilities**

**Solution Design and Configuration**

* Participate in discovery workshops and requirements-gathering sessions with Finance business stakeholders across multiple legal entities and geographies.
* Contribute to the functional design of Oracle Fusion Financials, including Chart of Accounts structure, ledger setup, SLA accounting rules, tax determination, and period-close processes.
* Prepare functional specifications, configuration workbooks, and gap-fit analyses under the guidance of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Perform configuration across GL, AP, AR, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets in line with agreed design decisions and Oracle best-practice standards.
* Support the setup of intercompany accounting, netting arrangements, and consolidation hierarchies for a multi-entity international group structure.

**General Ledger (GL)**

* Support Chart of Accounts configuration across multiple legal entities covering US, UK, Mexico, China, and India reporting requirements.
* Configure ledgers, accounting calendars, currencies, and intercompany balancing rules under direction.
* Assist with configuration and validation of Subledger Accounting (SLA) rules to ensure accurate accounting distributions from subledgers into the GL.
* Support period-end close activities including subledger close, revaluation, translation, and intercompany elimination runs.

**Accounts Payable (AP)**

* Configure AP functionality covering invoice management, three-way PO matching, payment processing, supplier setup, and BPM approval workflows.
* Configure and test multi-country electronic payment formats (SEPA, BACS, SWIFT, ACH, NEFT/RTGS) and payment process profiles aligned to each entity's banking arrangements.
* Support AP-to-GL accounting configuration including liability accounts, prepayments, withholding tax, and intercompany payables.

**Accounts Receivable (AR)**

* Configure AR functionality covering customer billing, AutoInvoice rule setup, multi-currency receipts, lockbox processing, and deductions management.
* Support the configuration of receipt application rules, aging bucket setups, and bad debt provisioning.
* Support AR-to-GL accounting distributions including revenue recognition and intercompany receivables setups.

**Cash Management**

* Support bank account structure setup and bank statement reconciliation configuration across group entities and banking relationships.
* Configure automated reconciliation rules, tolerance thresholds, and exception handling for multi-currency bank statement matching.
* Support testing of OIC-delivered bank interface integrations, including statement import formats, reconciliation mapping, and error handling.

**Tax, Oracle Tax**

* Configure Oracle Fusion Tax across applicable regimes including GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, and China VAT/Fapiao, under the direction of the Finance Functional Lead.
* Support the setup of tax determination rules, tax condition sets, and tax registration configurations, including scenarios such as intercompany transactions, imports and exports, reverse charge, and withholding tax.
* Support indirect tax compliance activities and help ensure Oracle tax outputs meet local statutory reporting requirements.

**Fixed Assets (FA)**

* Configure Fixed Assets functionality including corporate and tax asset books, depreciation methods, prorate conventions, and mass addition rules.
* Support CIP-to-asset capitalization workflows, asset retirement processes, and revaluation setups across operating jurisdictions.
* Support FA period-end close activities including depreciation runs and FA-to-GL reconciliation.

**Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work with Finance business users to clarify requirements and resolve day-to-day functional queries.
* Contribute to the Finance workstream across project phases: Discover, Design, Build, Test, and Deploy, ensuring assigned deliverables are completed on time and to quality.
* Prepare test scripts, execute SIT and UAT cycles, and log and track defects to closure.
* Collaborate with Oracle Fusion technical teams on RICEW deliverables, providing functional input on Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, and Workflows.
* Support OIC integration testing connecting Oracle Fusion Financials to banking, intercompany, and external systems.
* Continuously build product knowledge across Oracle Fusion Financials modules and work towards relevant Oracle certifications.

**Qualifications and Skills**

***Required***

* 3 or more years of hands-on Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials functional experience, including at least one full-cycle implementation or a major rollout, upgrade, or support engagement.
* Practical configuration experience across at least three of the core modules: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Tax, and Fixed Assets.
* Working knowledge of core Financials concepts including Chart of Accounts structures, ledger and accounting calendar setup, and Subledger Accounting (SLA).
* Experience preparing functional documentation such as configuration workbooks, functional specifications, and test scripts.
* Experience executing SIT and UAT cycles, logging defects, and tracking them to closure.
* Understanding of the period-end close process across subledgers and GL.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with Finance business users to clarify requirements.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.

***Preferred***

* Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials certification in one or more modules.
* Exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency, or multi-ledger environments.
* Experience with Oracle Tax configuration for one or more of GST (India), VAT (UK), IVA (Mexico), US Sales Tax, or China VAT.
* Familiarity with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) delivered interfaces, particularly bank and intercompany integrations, from a functional testing perspective.
* Working knowledge of BPM approval workflow configuration.
* Exposure to RICEW deliverables and collaboration with technical teams.
* A professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or part-qualified) is an advantage.

title: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – Australian Mortgages
description:
**Gandhinagar, Gujarat · Full time, in the office · Monday to Saturday, Australian hours · ₹15 LPA plus bonus**

Applications close Sunday 1 November 2026.

**FROM PRIYANK, THE FOUNDER**

Before I became a broker, I worked for the lenders: Lending Manager at Bank of Melbourne and Commercial Credit Analyst at La Trobe Financial. I started Prevail Finance in 2017. Today I meet our clients and structure their loans. I need one person I can hand every deal to: someone who knows Australian credit inside out, still works files themselves, and wants to build the team that gets every loan to settlement without me chasing it.

**HOW A DEAL MOVES HERE**

1. I meet the client, set the strategy and structure, and hand the deal to you with my notes.
2. You assess it: documents, income, serviceability and lender policy. You write the credit proposal, with lender options and risks, and we workshop it together.
3. I confirm the recommendation with the client. All credit advice stays with me as the licence holder.
4. You and your team package the file, lodge it through ApplyOnline, and take it through valuation, conditions, approval and loan documents to settlement.
5. Your team keeps the client updated at every step.

**WHAT YOU’RE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

Above all, one result: every loan we write settles on time, with no errors. You will:

* assess and write up the complex files yourself: self-employed, company and trust borrowers, business and commercial loans
* check your team’s work before anything reaches a lender: documents, servicing inputs, and the identity, anti-money-laundering and responsible lending checks
* keep SalesTrekker current, so every file has an owner, a next step and a date
* work with lenders and their BDMs on policy, pricing, conditions and valuations
* train and lead the loans team, and help choose its next hire

You report to me, and to a General Manager once we appoint one.

**A DAY IN THE ROLE**

You start early, on Australian hours. First the pipeline: which files need you, which settlements are close, what’s at risk. Then your own files: a new deal from me to assess, a credit proposal to finish, a condition to clear. Through the day you review your team’s files before lodgement, call BDMs, and unblock whatever is stuck. Each week you run the pipeline review. You finish in the afternoon IST, with every client updated and tomorrow’s priorities set.

**WHY THE RIGHT PERSON WILL WANT THIS**

* Real deals, not volume: business owners buying premises, commercial property, construction and business purchases, from $400k to $10M+.
* You learn from me. I’ve assessed these loans at a bank and at a non-bank lender, and I still develop property myself.
* You’re our first credit leader. You set the standards everyone after you works to.
* Premium pay, published: ₹15 LPA plus bonus.
* Your authority is in writing from day one. By day 90 you run the pipeline and I’ve stopped chasing files.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 5+ years assessing or processing Australian loans for brokers or lenders, onshore or offshore, from application to settlement
* Experience with self-employed borrowers trading through companies and trusts: financials, tax returns, add-backs
* Current hands-on work: you still work files yourself, not only supervise
* Experience leading, training or checking other people’s work
* A degree in commerce, accounting, finance or banking
* Clear spoken and written English: you’ll talk to Australian lenders every day

Even better: commercial, business, construction or development loans. Mercury, Infynity, BrokerEngine or SalesTrekker.

Not for you if: you’ve only worked on US or UK mortgages, or you’ve moved into management and no longer work files yourself.

**WHERE AND WHEN**

Our Gandhinagar office. You live within about 30 km, or relocate before you start. Monday to Saturday, on Australian hours: an early start and an afternoon finish, IST.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then email priyank@prevailfinance.com.au with your CV, current location and notice period, and a link to one video of up to five minutes answering:

1. An Australian loan file that was stuck or at risk of missing settlement, which you personally turned around: the lender, what was wrong, what you did, and what happened.
2. A time you held a colleague to a standard they weren’t meeting: what you said, and what happened next.
3. One thing in this ad you’d do differently, and why.

Record it on your phone, without a script. Send it as a Google Drive, unlisted YouTube or Loom link that anyone can open.

Subject line: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – your name

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

Every applicant gets a reply. Shortlisted applicants have a 60-minute interview with me, then a working session on a real past file with every client detail removed. On appointment: a written role agreement, a police check, and a three-month window to show the role works, for both sides. Every application is assessed on the same standard, and nothing without a bearing on the work counts.
