title: Trading Desk Manager - Prop Desk Operations & Risk
description:
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat · Full-time, in-office (open to candidates across India willing to relocate)

**Reports to:**
Founder / Head of Trading

**Experience:**
5+ years in F&O dealing, broker RMS, or prop desk operations

**Compensation:**
Competitive, based on experience

**About the desk**

We're scaling our proprietary quant trading desk in Ahmedabad. Our traders are active in NSE F&O at high volume, and as we grow our in-house trading team, we need a dedicated manager to own daily operations, risk, and trader coordination - so the founder can focus on strategy and the wider business.

This is a dynamic, hands-on role at the operational core of the desk. You'll be the first point of contact for every trader and the person who keeps margin, risk, and broker records in order, every single day. We're looking for someone with the proven judgment to read a situation fast and act decisively in the best interest of the company - whether that's holding the line on risk, resolving a broker dispute, or making the call under live-market pressure.

**What you'll do**

*Margin & risk*

* Allocate daily margin across traders based on strategy, performance, and limits
* Monitor intraday margin utilisation, MTM, and loss limits — and act before limits are breached
* Track exposure and concentration across the desk, and flag risks early

*Desk operations*

* Run the daily sync-up call: previous day's P&L, open positions, and the plan for the day
* Reconcile daily with the broker: contract notes, ledger, margin statements, and obligations
* Raise and resolve broker discrepancies the same day, with a clear written trail
* Keep desk records, limits, and procedures documented and current

*Trader support & escalation*

* Be the first point of contact for trader queries, platform issues, and order problems
* Resolve routine issues directly; escalate to the founder by agreed rules (loss limits, margin shortfall, broker issues)
* Enforce trading discipline and desk policies consistently

*Reporting*

* Send an end-of-day desk summary: P&L by trader, margin use, and exceptions
* Prepare a weekly performance and risk review for the founder

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in NSE F&O dealing, broker RMS (Risk Management System), or prop desk operations
* Hands-on knowledge of F&O margining: SPAN + exposure margin, peak margin rules, MTM settlement
* Experience reconciling contract notes, ledgers, and margin statements with brokers
* Strong Excel skills (pivots, lookups, daily MIS)
* A proven track record of managing live situations with sound judgment and acting in the best interest of the desk and the business
* Calm, firm judgment under live-market pressure
* Clear communication with traders and senior management
* Willing to work full-time from our Ahmedabad office

**Nice to have**

* NISM Series VII (Securities Operations & Risk Management) and/or NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives)
* Python or SQL for automating reports and risk checks
* Experience with algo, quant, or high-frequency trading desks
* Prior experience managing or coordinating a team of traders or dealers
* Gujarati or Hindi, in addition to English

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a live, high-volume F&O desk from day one
* Direct work with the founder, with real influence on how the desk is run and scaled
* A small, fast team with no layers between decisions and action
* Competitive pay based on experience

**How to apply**

Apply directly on LinkedIn, or email your CV to “hr@guru99.com” with the subject "Trading Desk Manager - Ahmedabad". Tell us your current location, notice period, and a few lines on the largest desk or RMS book you've managed.

* Hold an active CPA, EA or CA license. This is a client-facing tax role and the credential matters.
* Bring 3 to 5 years or more of complex tax return preparation in a public accounting environment, with real comfort across individual (1040) and business entity (1120S, 1065, 1120) tax returns.
* Prior experience to tax planning, tax advisory, notice resolution services is nice to have.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with clients, whether delivering a tax return, walking through a tax plan, or working a notice to resolution.
* Be comfortable with an advisory model built on annual engagements, planning, and consultation, rather than transactional, one-and-done compliance.
* Embrace AI for research, email smoothing and completeness, tax return preparation and review, and automation.
* Have strong business and rental property acumen including tax strategy beyond your garden-variety “max out your 401k” recommendation.
* Be willing to grow into review over time. You prepare first and review later, and that progression is part of the role.
* Stay current on federal and state tax developments without being asked. Intellectual curiosity must be in your DNA.
* Have at least a Bachelor’s degree, accounting preferred.

***Nice To Haves***

* Tax return signature authority, at least constructively.
* Business consulting or advisory experience beyond tax return preparation.
* Hands-on experience with Thomson Reuters UltraTax and SurePrep.
* Multi-state tax return experience including nexus and apportionment.

**Tax Supervisor Role Responsibilities**

You will work directly with other Tax Team Podmates and report to your Pod Leader, a Tax Manager or Partner. Your duties include WCG’s general Tax Team responsibilities plus, or as modified by, the following:

***Role-Specific Duties***

* Preparing complex individual (1040) and business entity (1120S, 1065, 1120) tax returns, starting at roughly 90% preparation and 10% review the first year and moving toward a 30% / 70% split as you gain reps.
* Delivering tax returns, tax plans, and payroll plans to clients, and signing tax returns on a per-client basis as directed by your Pod leader.
* Managing roughly 25 to 30 advisory engagements, plus another 25 to 50 tax-only engagements (TOEs) your first, and increasing to 100ish advisory and 150ish TOEs as you work towards being a Client Manager within the promoted role of Senior Tax Supervisor.
* Preparing tax plans and projections on a similar path, starting prep-heavy and evening out to a roughly 50/50 preparation and review split over time.
* Discussing tax strategies to reduce taxes and reviewing capitalization, participation and risk.
* Calculating salary and tax projections, entering shareholder payroll, and reviewing those numbers with clients.
* Resolving federal and state tax notices and other client issues.
* Researching complex or unusual tax questions, stress-testing with AI tools and drafting memos and conclusions.
* Handling the tax onboarding process for new clients and making sure the start is solid.
* Participating in prospect Discovery Meetings and other business development work alongside the Biz Dev team.

***General Tax Team Duties***

* Guiding WCG along the path of success.
* Promoting WCG culture and encouraging excellence and high team morale.
* Developing and implementing WCG goals, procedures, and policies in coordination with other Partners, Directors, Managers, and Podmates.
* Identifying improvement gaps and assisting with deploying corrective measures.
* Providing feedback, concerns, and recommendations to WCG leadership, including ideas that make the Tax service line better.
* Coordinating client-centric efforts across teams.
* Answering client phone calls and emails with professionalism and genuine care.
* Filing and organizing electronic documents and helping keep the workflow moving.
* Training and leading fellow Podmates as you gain experience.
* Other tasks related to tax, accounting, and consultation as requested.

Tax Supervisor responsibilities and duties will change from time to time depending on circumstances, your skill set, and the firm’s needs. They are reviewed, modified if necessary, and agreed to during Associate Reviews.

description:
**We are hiring for our client**

**Compensation- Max 10LPA**

You will be responsible for end-to-end SMSF processing and compliance work on \*\*BGL Simple Fund 360\*\*, from transaction processing through to audit-ready financial statements and the SMSF Annual Return. You will work directly with our Australian principal and support staff, and your work will be reviewed in Australia before lodgment.

**## Key Responsibilities**

* Process SMSF transactions in BGL Simple Fund 360, including setting up and maintaining bank, broker, and wrap data feeds
* Reconcile bank accounts, investment holdings, and contribution/pension transactions
* Process corporate actions, distributions (including annual tax statements from managed funds and ETFs), and property transactions
* Prepare annual financial statements, member statements, and trustee minutes/resolutions
* Prepare the SMSF Annual Return (SAR) for review and lodgment by the Australian team
* Calculate ECPI, apply actuarial certificates, and process CGT events correctly (including segregated vs proportionate method treatment)
* Monitor contribution caps (concessional, non-concessional, bring-forward) and flag potential breaches
* Prepare pension establishment, commutation, and minimum drawdown documentation
* Prepare Transfer Balance Account Report (TBAR) events for lodgment
* Prepare complete, audit-ready workpapers and respond to SMSF auditor queries promptly
* Maintain accurate fund records, permanent files, and workflow status updates
* Communicate clearly with the Australian team on queries, missing information, and job progress
* \*\*SMSF audit support (minor part of the role):\*\* assist with audit fieldwork, checklists, and evidence gathering for SMSF audit engagements — full training will be provided; prior audit experience is not required

**## Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Commerce, or Finance (CA/CPA/M.Com preferred)
* \*\*Minimum 2 years' hands-on experience processing Australian SMSFs\*\*, ideally within an outsourcing firm servicing Australian accounting or SMSF administration practices
* \*\*Demonstrated proficiency in BGL Simple Fund 360\*\* — data feeds, matching rules, corporate actions, pension processing, and report generation
* Sound working knowledge of Australian superannuation rules, including contribution caps, transfer balance cap, pension standards, and SIS Act/Regulations compliance requirements
* Understanding of Australian tax concepts relevant to SMSFs (franking credits, CGT discount, ECPI, non-arm's length income)
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate directly with an Australian team
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple funds to deadlines

**## Desirable (Not Essential)**

* Experience with Class Super, Xero, or document management tools (e.g. FYI Docs)
* Familiarity with SMSF audit requirements and common auditor queries
* Awareness of current Australian superannuation changes (e.g. contribution cap indexation, Payday Super, LRBA reforms)
* Experience preparing TBARs and dealing with ATO correspondence

**## What We Offer**

* Long-term, stable role with an established Australian practice
* Direct exposure to complex SMSF work (pensions, LRBAs, property, wind-ups) rather than data entry only
* Training and support on Australian regulatory updates
* Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Asst. Manager / Manager – Accounts & Finance
description:
**JOB PURPOSE**

To own the day-to-day accounts and finance of a young, fast-growing company — keeping books accurate and compliant, managing cash flow and reporting, and giving the founders reliable numbers to make quick decisions. The role is hands-on and calls for someone who is comfortable working in a lean team and building finance processes from the ground up.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Accounting & Bookkeeping**

* Maintain complete books of accounts in Tally — sales, purchase, journal, bank and petty cash entries — with accurate, timely posting.
* Perform bank, vendor and customer reconciliations; drive month-end and year-end closing and prepare the Balance Sheet, P&L and schedules.

**2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST (returns and GSTR-2B reconciliation), TDS / TCS, advance tax, PF / ESI / PT and other statutory filings within due dates.
* Support ROC / MCA filings and start-up related compliances; coordinate with auditors and tax consultants for statutory and tax audits.

**3. Cash Flow, Budgeting & Fund Management**

* Track the daily cash position, prepare cash-flow forecasts and monitor burn rate and runway; plan vendor and salary payments accordingly.
* Build budgets and review actuals vs. budget; provide financial data for investor reporting, fund-raising and due-diligence requests.

**4. MIS, Analysis & Cost Control**

* Prepare monthly MIS in Excel — P&L, department / project-wise costs, variance analysis and founder dashboards — with clear insights and recommendations.
* Monitor technology, cloud-infrastructure and SaaS subscription spends; handle foreign-currency vendor payments and their GST / FEMA implications.

**5. Billing, Receivables & Payables**

* Raise invoices accurately and on time; follow up on collections and maintain receivable ageing.
* Verify vendor bills and expense claims, and ensure timely, properly approved payments.

**6. Controls, Audit & Process Building**

* Set up and document accounting SOPs, approval workflows and internal controls suited to a fast-growing start-up.
* Support internal / statutory audits, explore automation of accounting workflows, and guide junior accounts staff (Manager level).

**KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Working knowledge of Tally and good command over MS Excel (pivot tables, lookups, formulas, MIS and dashboards).
* Sound understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and Companies Act provisions, and accounting standards.
* Strong analytical ability, attention to detail and the discipline to close books and meet statutory deadlines on time.
* Ownership mindset, comfort with ambiguity and a hands-on approach in a lean, fast-paced start-up environment.
* Clear communication with founders, auditors, vendors and investors; maintains strict confidentiality.

title: Senior Associate, Tax (EU/UK VAT)
description:
**About The Company**
e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face.
  
  
Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.
  
  
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands.
  
  
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry.
  
  
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a detail-oriented VAT Specialist with hands-on experience in EU and UK VAT compliance to join our finance team in Ahmedabad.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**VAT Preparation & Return Filing**

* Prepare EU and UK VAT returns on a periodic basis (monthly/quarterly as applicable per jurisdiction)
* File VAT returns with external consultant or relevant tax authorities across EU/UK region, ensuring timely and accurate submissions
* Maintain a filing calendar and track submission deadlines to avoid penalties and interest
* Support OSS/IOSS and non-Union scheme registrations and filings where applicable

**VAT Reconciliation**

* Perform monthly VAT reconciliations between Oracle Net Suite/SAP S/4HANA general ledger balances and VAT return figures
* Reconcile input and output VAT, identify discrepancies, and resolve variances in coordination with the accounts team
* Prepare reconciliation working papers and supporting documentation for review and audit trails

**VAT Compliance & Advisory Support**

* Apply up-to-date knowledge of EU/UK VAT law, rules, and regulations to ensure compliance across all jurisdictions
* Support the application of correct VAT treatment to transactions (place of supply, reverse charge, intra-community supplies, exports, B2B/B2C rules)

**VAT Audit & Assessment**

* Handle VAT audits and assessments initiated by EU/UK tax authorities; prepare responses, documentation, and supporting evidence
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external advisors to resolve audit queries and disputes
* Manage correspondence with tax authorities regarding assessments, refunds, and reassessments

**Systems & Process**

* Work extensively with Oracle Net Suite/SAP S/4HANA to extract, validate, and report VAT-relevant data
* Use Microsoft Excel (advanced) for data analysis and reconciliations
* Identify process improvement opportunities to streamline VAT compliance workflows

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Communicate effectively with EU/UK-based teams, tax advisors, and finance counterparts
* Clearly explain VAT positions, queries, and requirements to non-tax stakeholders
* Maintain professional correspondence with external tax authorities and consultants

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CA/ACCA/CPA (qualified or partially qualified) or an equivalent tax qualification is preferred
* Experience: 2-5 years of relevant experience in EU/UK VAT preparation, reconciliation, and return filing
* Technical Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of EU and UK VAT law, rules, and compliance procedures across multiple jurisdictions
* ERP/Tax software Experience: Hands-on experience with Oracle Net Suite/SAP S/4HANA/Avalara , including VAT-related data extraction and GL reconciliation
* Excel Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel — including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and data reconciliation techniques
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact professionally with international stakeholders and tax authorities
* Attention to Detail: High accuracy in numerical work and documentation

*This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this position. It also reflects the general details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job identified, and shall not be considered, as detailed description of all the work required inherent in the job. It is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, and it is subject to changes and exceptions at the supervisors’ discretion.*

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Associate – Domestic Accounting & Taxation
description:
**Company:**
BKCProHub (Legal Name: BKC Consultants Private Limited)

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Open Positions:**
1

**Experience:**
Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in the accounting, tax or audit industry, including articleship experience

**Mandatory Qualification:**
CA Intermediate passed or article ship completed

**Compensation:**
₹3.6–5.4 lakh CTC per annum, depending on experience and competence

About BKCProHub

BKCProHub is a global accounting and tax services firm providing accounting, taxation, audit support, financial reporting and compliance services to businesses across India and international markets.

We are committed to delivering technically sound, timely and transparent services through strong accounting fundamentals, standardised processes, effective review and technology-enabled workflows.

Role Overview

We are looking for an Accounting & Tax Associate to handle domestic accounting, Indian tax compliance, audit assistance and financial statement preparation for Indian clients.

The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end accounting activities, GST compliance, income tax and TDS-related work, assistance with audit assignments, and compilation of financial statements.

The role requires a strong practical understanding of Indian accounting and taxation, attention to detail, excellent communication skills and the ability to manage assignments independently while escalating technical matters when necessary.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Accounting

* Maintain books of account for domestic clients, including journal entries, general ledger accounting, AR, AP, banking and expense recording.
* Record and classify financial transactions accurately and in the appropriate accounting periods.
* Perform bank, customer, supplier and general ledger reconciliations.
* Prepare and review schedules for accruals, prepayments, depreciation, provisions and other year-end adjustments.
* Conduct ledger scrutiny and identify unusual balances, misclassifications and potential errors.
* Follow up with clients for missing invoices, bank statements, supporting documents and other accounting information.
* Assist with monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities.

2. GST Compliance

* Prepare and assist with GST return preparation and filing, including applicable GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B returns.
* Reconcile sales and purchase records with GST returns and available portal data, including GSTR-2B where applicable.
* Review input tax credit eligibility, tax classifications and reconciliation differences.
* Assist with GST registrations, amendments, annual compliance and related documentation, as required.
* Identify discrepancies, potential compliance risks and missing documentation.
* Assist with GST notices, departmental queries and reconciliations under appropriate supervision.

3. Income Tax & TDS

* Prepare and assist with income tax return preparation for businesses and other applicable taxpayers.
* Compute taxable income and prepare supporting schedules and tax workings.
* Prepare TDS computations, review deductions and assist with applicable TDS return preparation and filing.
* Reconcile TDS balances with books of account, challans, returns and available tax credit statements.
* Assist with tax audit documentation, tax computations and supporting schedules, as applicable.
* Track statutory deadlines and maintain organised compliance records.
* Assist with responses to tax notices and other departmental requirements under supervision.

4. Audit Assistance

* Assist with statutory audits, tax audits and other audit assignments, as applicable.
* Prepare audit schedules, lead schedules, reconciliations and supporting working papers.
* Obtain and organise supporting documentation for audit procedures.
* Assist in ledger scrutiny, verification of balances and preparation of audit evidence.
* Coordinate with clients to obtain information and explanations required for audit completion.
* Track audit queries and observations and follow up on pending items.
* Support the preparation of financial statements and audit-related documentation.

5. Financial Statement Compilation

* Compile financial statements from the trial balance, general ledger and supporting schedules.
* Prepare balance sheets, statements of profit and loss, cash flow statements where applicable, and relevant notes and disclosures.
* Ensure financial statement balances reconcile with the underlying books and supporting schedules.
* Assist with year-end closing, finalisation of accounts and preparation of financial reporting documentation.
* Identify inconsistencies, missing disclosures and unusual balances for review.
* Ensure financial statements are prepared in accordance with the applicable accounting framework and statutory requirements, subject to appropriate review.

6. Client Communication & Relationship Management

* Communicate professionally with clients to obtain accounting records, tax information and supporting documents.
* Draft clear and professional emails relating to compliance requirements, outstanding information, reconciliations and tax queries.
* Explain routine accounting and compliance matters clearly to clients.
* Maintain compliance trackers, client query lists and filing calendars.
* Follow up proactively on outstanding information and communicate potential delays.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise professional judgement when handling client information.

7. Quality & Process Compliance

* Follow established SOPs, checklists, filing calendars and documentation standards.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records and tax computations.
* Address review comments promptly and maintain proper supporting evidence.
* Identify recurring errors and recommend improvements to accounting and compliance processes.
* Maintain a disciplined approach to deadlines, workpaper preparation and task completion.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills

* CA Intermediate passed or Article ship completed.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant industry experience, including articleship, in accounting, taxation or audit.
* Practical working knowledge of Indian accounting and financial reporting.
* Hands-on exposure to GST, income tax and TDS compliance.
* Experience in accounting, reconciliations and preparation of financial statements.
* Very good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple assignments.
* Working knowledge of Excel and accounting software.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in a CA firm or professional accounting and tax services organisation.
* Practical exposure to Tally, Zoho Books or other accounting software.
* Experience in GST reconciliations, TDS returns, tax computations and audit working papers.
* Familiarity with statutory compliance calendars and financial statement compilation.
* Ability to independently handle routine client assignments and identify issues requiring senior review.

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate:

* Timely and accurate completion of accounting and tax assignments.
* Reliable preparation of GST, income tax and TDS workings and supporting documentation.
* Proper reconciliations and complete accounting records.
* Accurate compilation of financial statements and audit schedules.
* Professional client communication and proactive follow-up.
* Compliance with statutory deadlines, SOPs and review procedures.

What We Offer

* Exposure to diverse domestic clients and industries.
* Opportunities to develop expertise across accounting, taxation, audit support and financial reporting.
* A structured environment with clear workflows and quality standards.
* Professional growth based on technical capability, communication and ownership of work.

**Application:**
Candidates should submit their CV highlighting completed articleship, relevant accounting and tax experience, GST and TDS exposure, audit assistance and financial statement preparation.

title: Senior Manager - Accounts & Finance (Bookkeeping Consolidation)
description:
**PSP PROJECTS LIMITED**
**Job Description**
**Finance Manager - Financial Closing & Reporting**
**Function**
Finance & Accounts
  
  
**Location**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Experience**
9-12 years
  
  
**Employment Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Reporting To**
CFO
  
  
**Industry**
EPC / Construction
  
  
**Qualification**
CA with relevant experience will be considered only
  
  
**ERP**
Strong working knowledge of SAP
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own and drive the end-to-end monthly, quarterly and annual book-closing process, ensuring accurate financial reporting, timely consolidation and strong compliance. The role will work closely with project teams, business finance, auditors and senior management to strengthen financial controls and deliver reliable management and statutory reporting for a listed EPC company.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Financial closing: Lead monthly, quarterly and annual closure of books, including closure calendar, cut-off controls, accruals, provisions, estimates, reconciliations and review of closing entries.
* Consolidation and reporting: Prepare and review standalone and consolidated financial statements, schedules and disclosures in line with applicable Ind AS, Companies Act requirements and listing-related reporting timelines.
* Project and EPC accounting: Oversee project-wise revenue and cost accounting, contract assets and liabilities, unbilled revenue, retention, work-in-progress, subcontractor accounting, material consumption, site overheads, provisions and project close-out accounting.
* SAP and data integrity: Ensure completeness and accuracy of SAP ledgers, profit centres, cost centres and project structures; drive timely resolution of interface, mapping and master-data issues.
* Balance-sheet governance: Review key balance-sheet reconciliations, ageing, open items, advances, GR/IR, inter-unit and related-party balances and ensure clear ownership and closure of exceptions.
* Statutory audit: Coordinate with statutory auditors, manage audit schedules and information requests, support resolution of observations and ensure timely completion of limited reviews and annual audit.
* Related party transactions: Identify, record, reconcile and disclose related party transactions and balances; support their review, approval and reporting to the Audit Committee and Board in line with SEBI LODR and Companies Act requirements.
* Revenue and lease accounting: Apply and review percentage-of-completion / contract revenue accounting (Ind AS 115) and lease accounting (Ind AS 116), including estimates, judgements and supporting documentation.
* Taxation coordination: Coordinate with the tax team on GST, TDS, tax audit, deferred tax and reconciliation of books with tax and statutory records.
* Compliance and controls: Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal financial controls, statutory requirements and internal closing SOPs; identify control gaps and implement practical corrective actions.
* Internal financial controls: Support design, testing and evidencing of internal financial controls over reporting (IFCoFR) and follow through on internal audit observations.
* Regulatory filings: Support timely and accurate financial disclosures, XBRL filings and other listing-related submissions in coordination with the Company Secretary.
* Management and investor reporting: Prepare accurate financial inputs, analyses and slides for management reviews, Board/Audit Committee packs, investor presentations and quarterly result communication.
* Digital enablement: Use SAP capabilities, Excel, Power Query, BI tools, workflow automation and AI-enabled productivity tools to reduce manual work, improve controls and accelerate reporting.
* Cross-functional coordination: Work with project, procurement, commercial, billing, taxation, treasury, legal and secretarial teams to obtain complete and timely closure inputs.
* Team leadership: Guide and review the work of finance team members, set clear timelines, build back-up capability and promote a disciplined, ownership-driven closing culture.

****Candidate Profile****

* Experience: 9-12 years of relevant post-qualification experience, with substantial hands-on responsibility for end-to-end book closing and financial reporting.
* Listed-company exposure: Current or recent experience in a listed company, including quarterly reporting, limited review, year-end audit and management or investor reporting.
* Sector experience: Strong preference for EPC, construction, infrastructure, engineering or project-based businesses with multi-location operations.
* ERP capability: Strong working knowledge of SAP FI/CO and practical experience in extracting, validating and reconciling large data sets.
* Technical knowledge: Sound understanding of Ind AS (including revenue and lease standards), consolidation, Schedule III, related party disclosures, segment reporting and internal financial controls.
* Regulatory awareness: Working knowledge of SEBI LODR reporting timelines, XBRL and interaction with the secretarial function.
* Execution strength: Demonstrated record of completing closure within defined timelines without compromising accuracy, documentation or control.
* Communication: Ability to present financial matters clearly to senior management and coordinate effectively with auditors and non-finance stakeholders.

****Key Competencies****

* Results-focused, with strong ownership of timelines and closure quality
* High attention to detail, supported by a practical understanding of materiality and business impact
* Strong analytical and reconciliation skills, with the ability to identify root causes
* Calm and dependable during peak reporting periods
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to follow up firmly and professionally
* Control-oriented, while remaining practical and solution-focused
* Comfortable working across multiple projects, locations and stakeholders
* Continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to challenge inefficient processes
* High integrity and professional scepticism, with sound judgement on estimates and disclosures

**Preferred Background**
Candidates who have independently managed at least three annual closing and audit cycles in a listed, project-based organisation will be preferred. Experience in improving the close process, implementing reporting automation or supporting investor/Board reporting will be an added advantage.

title: Manager / Sr. Executive – Affiliate & Brand Alliances (Beauty / D2C)
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an owner who can scale affiliate, cashback, coupon and fintech/super-app partnerships into a core revenue channel. The goal is low-CAC incremental sales and new-customer acquisition across our D2C website and marketplace.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Affiliate Programs
* Build and scale the in-house D2C affiliate program on Shopify Plus, covering partner onboarding, tracking links, payouts and fraud control.
* Manage third-party affiliate networks and portals (Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission, Impact, etc.) and continuously add new publishers.
* Onboard influencers, creators, content/review sites and deal communities as affiliate partners.
* Cashback & Coupon Ecosystem
* Build partnerships and run campaigns with cashback portals (CashKaro, GoPaisa, etc.) and coupon portals (GrabOn, CouponDunia, etc.).
* Own the brand-wise coupon strategy: code structure, discount depth, exclusivity, leakage control, and monitoring of coupon abuse and brand-bidding.
* Super-App & Rewards Partnerships
* Launch offers, coupons, rewards and co-branded campaigns on platforms such as PhonePe, Paytm, Google Pay and Zomato.
* Explore new platforms and bank, fintech and loyalty partnerships that bring in high-intent customers.
* Planning & Campaigns
* Create a partner-wise campaign calendar for launches, festive sales (Diwali, BFCM, EOSS) and key SKUs.
* Negotiate commission structures: CPS/CPA, tiered, performance-linked and exclusive deals.
* Tracking, Analytics & Reporting
* Track clicks, orders, AOV, new vs. repeat customers, CAC, ROAS, commission payouts and incrementality.
* Ensure accurate attribution (UTM, coupon-level, network-level) and catch fake or duplicate conversions.
* Build weekly/monthly dashboards and partner scorecards; pause low performers and scale winners.
* Cross-functional Coordination
* Work with Brand, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Creative, Finance and Tech teams on offers, creatives, tracking setup and payout reconciliation.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field (MBA/PGDM preferred).
* 3–6 years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, performance or e-commerce marketing. Beauty, D2C or FMCG background preferred.
* Hands-on experience with affiliate networks/platforms (Impact, Cuelinks, Admitad, vCommission) and cashback/coupon portals.
* Strong understanding of coupon-led and offer-led growth (CPS/CPA, margin math, abuse control).
* Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets; working knowledge of GA4 and Shopify analytics.

Good to Have
  
  

* Experience with super-app/fintech offer platforms (PhonePe, Paytm, GPay, Zomato) or bank/credit-card reward partnerships.
* Understanding of marketplace affiliate programs (Amazon, Nykaa).

Success Metrics (first 6–12 months)
  
  

* Share of revenue and new-customer count from the affiliate/partnership channel.
* Blended CAC and ROAS within target.
* Number of active partners and top-partner concentration.
* Minimal coupon leakage and invalid payouts.

description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Investment Analyst to support a family office's multi-asset investment portfolio. The ideal candidate will conduct investment research, evaluate opportunities across multiple asset classes, and develop actionable investment recommendations tailored to the needs of Ultra-High-Net-Worth Individuals (UHNI) and family offices.

This role requires strong financial and analytical capabilities, sound investment judgment, and the ability to leverage AI tools to improve research efficiency and decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Investment Research:**
  Research and evaluate investment opportunities across listed equities, fixed income and debt instruments, REITs, InvITs, and structured products.

* **Portfolio Monitoring:**
  Track existing portfolio holdings, assess investment performance, monitor risks, and identify key market developments and investment catalysts.

  Evaluate investment opportunities based on risk-return profiles, market conditions, valuation, and portfolio objectives.

  Effectively use AI tools to accelerate research, investment screening, data analysis, and drafting while applying independent judgment to validate findings and conclusions.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Monitor relevant market trends, economic developments, and regulatory changes that may affect investment decisions.
* **Investment Support:**
  Assist in evaluating new opportunities and providing research-backed insights to support portfolio allocation and investment decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* **CA (Chartered Accountant) or equivalent qualification, along with CFA Level III candidacy or higher — mandatory.**
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in buy-side research, family offices, wealth management, investment research, or related financial services roles is preferred.
* Strong analytical, financial modeling, research, and critical-thinking skills.
* Good understanding of investment products commonly used by UHNIs and family offices.
* Ability to evaluate investment opportunities across multiple asset classes and articulate the associated risks and potential returns.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to enhance research workflows, screening, analysis, and documentation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex investment ideas clearly and concisely.
* High ownership mindset, attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and a strong sense of accountability.

Over the years, KCM has established itself as a ‘global outreach firm’ serving clients from across continents and in major jurisdictions, including the US, Germany and other parts of Europe, Japan, Taiwan, Middle East, ASEAN, etc. KCM has evolved as a trusted advisor not only for individuals and corporates but also as a trusted partner for consulting firms and associations across the globe with its uncanny knack of understanding the expectations and requirements of different cultures and geographies.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a highly motivated professional to join our Forensic & Risk Advisory team. The role involves conducting forensic investigations, fraud risk assessments, whistle-blower reviews, and special audits to identify financial irregularities, fraud, misconduct, and control weaknesses. The candidate will be responsible for analysing financial and operational data, evaluating evidence, preparing investigation reports, and providing actionable recommendations to management while maintaining the highest standards of integrity, confidentiality, and professional ethics.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct forensic investigations, special audits, whistle-blower reviews, and ethics-related engagements to identify fraud, financial irregularities, misconduct, and control deficiencies.
* Analyse financial and non-financial data through transaction testing, document reviews, trend analysis, data analytics, and exception reporting to identify potential risk indicators.
* Evaluate internal controls, business processes, and governance frameworks to identify gaps and recommend improvements.
* Perform fact-finding procedures, evidence gathering, document reviews, and stakeholder interviews while maintaining confidentiality and professional skepticism.
* Prepare comprehensive reports detailing findings, root causes, financial impact, and recommendations for senior management and clients.
* Support fraud risk assessments and investigations involving employee misconduct, vendor fraud, financial statement manipulation, and other financial crimes.
* Execute special assignments and risk advisory engagements for clients across various industries as required.

**Qualification**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) and/or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE).
* 0-3 years of experience in Forensic Investigation, Fraud Risk Management, Forensic Audit, Internal Audit, or Risk Consulting.

**Technical Skills**

* Understanding of forensic review methodologies, fraud risk assessment frameworks, and investigative procedures.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience in reviewing large volumes of financial and operational data.
* Exposure to forensic technology and e-discovery tools such as Intella, IDEA, eDiscovery, or similar platforms is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP ERP or other enterprise systems will be an added advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, data analytics, and reporting tools.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* High level of integrity, professional skepticism, and ethical conduct.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Strong report-writing, presentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple assignments, and perform effectively under tight timelines.

* Manage procurement across technology and SaaS categories, including software licences, cloud and data services, IoT devices, sensors, gateways, networking equipment, hardware and related services.

title: General Accountant
description:
**About the Company**

Medovate Pvt Ltd is the India-based Global Capability Centre (GCC) for the Kelta group, a multi-entity international group with operating companies in the United States, United Kingdom, Mexico, China and India. Group entities include Ultimate Training Munitions (UTM), Tii Technologies, ELEY, Killough Shooting Sports, Eurocraft Technologies and Medovate UK. All group entities run on a single Oracle Fusion Cloud tenancy. From Ahmedabad, Medovate delivers Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP services, IT operations and business process support to the group.

**About the Role**

You will do the day-to-day accounting for some of the group's US and Hong Kong entities: processing supplier invoices, raising customer invoices, applying cash, posting journals, reconciling bank accounts and helping close the books every month. This is a hands-on processing role, not an analysis or reporting role. The work is real transactional accounting for real operating companies in two countries, on a modern cloud ERP, with month-end deadlines that matter. You will work directly with finance and operations colleagues in the US and Hong Kong, so you will be emailing and speaking with them regularly rather than sitting behind a queue. The team is small and growing, which means you will learn the full cycle rather than being boxed into one narrow task.

**Responsibilities**

**Accounts Payable**

* Capture and code supplier invoices in Oracle Fusion, matching them against purchase orders and receipts and resolving mismatches with the requester or the supplier.
* Route non-PO invoices for approval and chase approvers so nothing ages in the queue.
* Prepare payment runs for review across multiple entities, banks and currencies, including USD, HKD and INR.
* Reconcile supplier statements, investigate debit balances and unapplied prepayments, and keep AP ageing clean.
* Respond to supplier queries on payment status and resolve disputes.
* Process employee expense claims and reconcile corporate card transactions against the group travel and expense policy.
* Support jurisdiction-specific requirements: collecting W-9 forms and maintaining 1099 data for US suppliers, handling Hong Kong supplier invoices correctly (Hong Kong has no VAT or GST, so the treatment differs from what most Indian accountants are used to) including withholding on royalties and fees paid to non-residents, and applying GST and TDS correctly for the India entity.

**Accounts Receivable**

* Generate and issue customer invoices from sales orders and shipments, and deliver them through the correct channel or portal.
* Apply incoming cash against invoices, match remittance advices, and investigate unapplied and unidentified receipts.
* Prepare AR ageing reports and send dunning and reminder emails on overdue accounts.
* Handle customer queries on invoices and statements, and escalate genuine disputes to the commercial owner.
* Process credit memos and returns with the right approvals and documentation.

**General Ledger and month-end close**

* Post journal entries, accruals, prepayments and recurring entries accurately and on time.
* Perform bank, cash and credit card reconciliations and clear open items rather than carrying them forward.
* Maintain the fixed asset register and post depreciation.
* Post and match intercompany transactions between group entities, and help reconcile intercompany balances.
* Complete your assigned tasks on the month-end close checklist to the published deadline.
* Prepare balance sheet schedules and account substantiation backup.
* Pull supporting documentation for statutory and group auditors during audit season.

**Systems and process**

* Work in Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials daily across Payables, Receivables, Cash Management, General Ledger and Expenses.
* Build and run reports using OTBI and Smart View rather than rekeying data into spreadsheets.
* Follow the documented SOPs, flag where they are wrong or out of date, and help keep them current.
* Meet the agreed quality and turnaround standards for your processes, and raise issues early when you are going to miss one.

**Qualifications**

* B.Com or M.Com. CA Inter, CMA Inter, or a part-qualified ACCA is welcome but not required.
* 2 to 5 years of hands-on accounting experience covering at least two of accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger.
* Practical experience in an ERP. Oracle Fusion is ideal, but SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, Xero or QuickBooks all count.
* Working knowledge of double-entry accounting that goes beyond data entry. You should be able to explain why an entry hits the accounts it hits.
* Solid Excel: lookups, pivot tables, and comfort reconciling two data sets against each other.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will be writing to suppliers, customers and colleagues in the US and Hong Kong every week.
* Accuracy and follow-through. This role is judged on whether the numbers are right and whether open items get closed.

**Required Skills**

* Experience supporting US or Hong Kong entities, or working in a GCC, captive centre, shared services centre or accounting outsourcing firm.
* Exposure to multi-entity or multi-currency accounting.
* Familiarity with US sales and use tax, US 1099 reporting, Hong Kong profits tax, or reporting under HKFRS.
* Experience with invoice automation, OCR capture or expense management tools.

**Preferred Skills**

* Organised. You keep a list, you work it, and things do not fall through.
* Curious enough to ask why rather than posting what you were told to post.
* Comfortable owning a mistake early instead of hoping it will not surface at close.
* Willing to work across a split coverage window: an early enough start to overlap with Hong Kong business hours, and availability into US Eastern hours during month-end close. This is a requirement of the role, not an occasional ask.

**What's In It For You**
Exposure to end-to-end fixed-asset and management-accounting activities in a Finance Operations environment.
  
  
Opportunities to develop experience in capital expenditure accounting, financial reporting and SOX compliance.
  
  
Collaboration with managers, leaders and other stakeholders across group and market finance teams.
  
  
Practical involvement in monthly, quarterly and annual reporting cycles.
  
  
Opportunities to use data, enterprise systems and emerging AI capabilities to support accurate financial operations
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Fixed-asset accounting across capitalisation, disposal and depreciation activities.
  
  
Capital and operating expenditure classification.
  
  
Interface, subledger and balance-sheet reconciliation.
  
  
Management information preparation and financial reporting.
  
  
SOX control execution and service-level management.
  
  
Advanced application of Excel, SAP or ERP platforms, Power BI and Microsoft Copilot.
  
  
Stakeholder communication and interpretation of new accounting procedures.

Price Book Assistant

Location: Ahmedabad, India (Remote until Office is Established)

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Experience Required: 4–5+ Years

CTC: ₹75,000 – ₹1,00,000 per month

Work Hours: US Shift – Must overlap at least 5 hours with US Eastern Time (approx. 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST, or as agreed)

Reports To: Owner

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Price Book Assistant to manage pricing accuracy across multiple retail stores. The role will focus on maintaining accurate cost and retail pricing, ensuring margins are properly maintained, updating prices when vendor costs change, and preparing regular sales and pricing reports for management.

The ideal candidate should be highly detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers and Excel, and experienced in retail pricing, merchandising, bookkeeping, inventory, or other accuracy-focused roles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales Book / Sales Summary Reporting

- Prepare recurring sales summaries for management review.

- Analyze sales performance by item, category, and store.

- Generate and review sales reports using the retail back-office system.

- Compare sales performance across individual stores and the overall business.

- Use sales data to support pricing, purchasing, and inventory decisions.

- Maintain accurate and timely reporting for management.

2. Pricing & Margin Management

- Ensure retail prices accurately reflect current product costs and required margins.

- Review item-level pricing and identify pricing or margin discrepancies.

- Update retail prices whenever vendor costs change.

- Audit margins by item, category, and store.

- Identify products that are underpriced, over-priced, or not meeting the required margin.

- Ensure pricing changes are accurately reflected across the required stores.

3. Excel-Based Price & Cost Updates

- Prepare and manage bulk price and cost changes using Microsoft Excel.

- Review and cross-check pricing data before importing updates into the retail back-office system.

- Perform mass price and cost updates where required.

- Ensure imported pricing data is accurate and meets the required margin structure.

- Maintain proper records of pricing changes and updates.

4. Price Book Accuracy & Maintenance

- Maintain the accuracy of the price book across multiple stores.

- Review item costs, retail prices, margins, and related pricing information regularly.

- Identify and correct discrepancies in pricing and cost data.

- Coordinate with relevant teams/vendors when cost or pricing information needs clarification.

- Ensure pricing information remains consistent and up to date across stores.

Required Qualifications

- 4–5+ years of experience in retail pricing, merchandising, bookkeeping, inventory, purchasing, or a similar detail-oriented, numbers-focused role.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work with repetitive, accuracy-critical data.

- Good understanding of cost, retail price, markup, and margin calculations.

- Strong Microsoft Excel skills for reviewing, comparing, and updating pricing data.

- Comfortable working with POS / retail back-office systems.

- Prior experience with ECRS Catapult is an advantage but not mandatory.

- Ability to analyze sales and pricing reports and identify discrepancies.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage large volumes of item and pricing data.

- Willingness to work in a US shift and maintain the required overlap with US Eastern Time.

What We’re Looking For

Someone who is highly detail-oriented and comfortable working with pricing, costs, margins, Excel, and large volumes of retail data. The candidate should be able to identify pricing discrepancies, maintain accurate price books across multiple stores, and provide reliable sales and pricing reports to management.

title: Senior Manager Budget Control & Management Accounting
description:
**Job Purpose**

The Senior Manager / AGM – Budget Control & Management Accounting will be responsible for establishing and managing a proactive budget control framework across Ishan Technologies Pvt. Ltd. and Saksham AI Private Limited. The role focuses on preventing unbudgeted or inefficient expenditure through pre-commitment budget checks, monitoring actual expenditure against approved budgets, identifying cost inefficiencies, and driving corrective actions in collaboration with department heads (HODs).

The position will ensure financial discipline, accountability, cost optimization, and effective management reporting, with regular reporting to the CFO on budget adherence, exceptions, savings, and corrective action progress.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**A. Budget Control & Expenditure Governance**

* Design, implement, and manage the budget control workflow across both entities, including approval thresholds, authorization matrices, escalation procedures, and CFO sign-offs.
* Ensure all expenditure commitments above the defined threshold are checked against approved budgets before purchase orders (POs), contracts, hiring commitments, capital expenditure (CAPEX), or operating expenditure (OPEX) are finalized.
* Hold expenditure requests that exceed approved budgets until appropriate justification and authorization are obtained.
* Ensure exceptions are properly documented and approved by the designated authority before commitments are made.
* Coordinate with Finance, Procurement, HR, and business departments to strengthen budget adherence and expenditure controls.
* Review compliance with established budget approval policies and recommend improvements to prevent unauthorized spending.

**B. Management Accounting & Budget Monitoring**

* Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets across cost centers, departments, and business entities.
* Prepare monthly budget-versus-actual reports, variance analysis, forecasts, and management reports.
* Identify budget deviations, overspending trends, recurring variances, and emerging financial risks.
* Analyze expenditure patterns to identify cost inefficiencies, duplicate vendor expenses, project costing discrepancies, and avoidable overruns.
* Provide actionable financial insights to HODs and senior management to improve cost visibility and spending decisions.
* Support periodic budget revisions, reforecasting, and financial planning exercises.

**C. Cost Optimization & Corrective Action Management**

* Investigate the root causes of budget variances and inefficient expenditure in collaboration with the concerned HODs.
* Recommend specific corrective actions with clearly defined responsibilities, timelines, and expected financial outcomes.
* Develop and maintain a corrective action tracker covering identified issues, root causes, agreed actions, accountable owners, deadlines, and closure status.
* Follow up on agreed actions and ensure timely implementation of corrective measures.
* Escalate unresolved corrective actions to the CFO if they remain open beyond two review cycles, along with the HOD's explanation and supporting details.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, expenditure avoidance, process improvement, and improved utilization of financial resources.
* Validate reported cost savings and expenditure avoidance using appropriate financial evidence.

**D. Budget Reviews & Stakeholder Management**

* Conduct monthly or fortnightly budget review meetings with HODs across both entities.
* Review cost center performance, budget utilization, forecast expenditure, pending commitments, and significant variances.
* Obtain variance explanations from HODs within defined timelines and agree on corrective actions.
* Challenge non-essential or inefficient spending through data-driven analysis and constructive stakeholder discussions.
* Promote financial accountability among department heads and encourage proactive budget management.
* Present budget health, major exceptions, cost optimization initiatives, and corrective action updates to the CFO.

**E. Financial Reporting, Governance & Compliance**

* Prepare periodic reports and dashboards covering budget adherence, cost center performance, expenditure trends, financial exceptions, and corrective action status.
* Maintain accurate records of budget approvals, exception requests, expenditure commitments, and management review outcomes.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for budget control effectiveness and cost optimization.
* Ensure budget control processes are aligned with the organization's financial policies, delegated authority matrix, and internal control requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining appropriate documentation and audit trails.
* Recommend improvements to ERP-based budget controls, purchase order workflows, reporting systems, and financial governance processes.

**F. Team Management**

* Lead, guide, and develop the analyst team supporting budget control and management accounting across both entities.
* Allocate responsibilities, review analytical outputs, and ensure the timely preparation of reports and variance analyses.
* Establish consistent reporting standards, review mechanisms, and performance expectations for the team.
* Build team capabilities in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and management reporting.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* CA, CMA, or an equivalent relevant professional qualification.
* 8–12 years of relevant experience in management accounting, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), budgeting, cost control, or financial governance.

title: Lead - Treasury
description:
**Responsibilities**
**Treasury & Liquidity Management**

* Lead treasury operations, cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and fund management across the business.
* Develop short-term and long-term cash flow plans to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
* Drive working capital optimization initiatives and improve cash conversion cycles.
* Monitor fund utilization, liquidity positions, borrowing costs, and treasury risk exposure.
* Coordinate with Group Treasury for fund deployment, cash pooling, and liquidity management strategies.

**Fund Raising & Project Finance**

* Lead end-to-end fund-raising activities for existing and upcoming projects.
* Manage project financing, including lender engagement, financial closure, documentation, drawdowns, and disbursements.
* Evaluate and implement optimal financing structures through debt, equity, structured finance, and hybrid instruments.

**Banking Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, investors, and rating agencies.
* Negotiate competitive pricing, credit facilities, banking limits, and financing terms.
* Lead consortium banking arrangements and multi-bank financing structures.
* Manage enhancement and renewal of working capital and project finance facilities.

**Trade Finance & Banking Operations**

* Manage end-to-end trade finance transactions, including:

+ Import & Export Letters of Credit (LCs)
+ Bank Guarantees (BGs)
+ Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs)
+ Buyers' and Suppliers' Credit

* Oversee issuance, amendments, negotiations, renewals, and closure of trade finance instruments.
* Ensure timely settlement of import/export transactions and compliance with banking obligations.

**Debt Management & Compliance**

* Manage debt portfolio, including drawdowns, repayments, refinancing, interest servicing, and covenant monitoring.
* Ensure compliance with financing agreements, lender reporting, and debt covenants.
* Prepare CMA data, stock statements, drawing power calculations, utilization certificates, and banking MIS.
* Ensure compliance with RBI, FEMA, banking regulations, and trade finance guidelines.
* Monitor documentation, statutory submissions, and regulatory reporting requirements.

**Forex & Risk Management**

* Manage foreign exchange exposures arising from imports, exports, borrowings, and cross-border transactions.
* Develop and implement hedging strategies through forward contracts and other treasury products.
* Monitor interest rate and currency risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Ensure adherence to treasury risk management frameworks and policies.

**Treasury Digitalization & Process Excellence**

* Drive treasury automation initiatives and implementation of digital banking platforms.
* Improve treasury workflows through technology-enabled solutions and process optimization.
* Establish treasury controls, governance frameworks, and best practices.
* Enhance operational efficiency through dashboarding, automation, and reporting tools.

**MIS & Leadership Reporting**

* Prepare treasury dashboards, cash position reports, debt reports, banking MIS, and fund utilization reports.
* Present key treasury metrics and funding updates to senior management.
* Provide actionable insights on liquidity, borrowing costs, treasury risks, and capital deployment.

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification**

* CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA / FRM from a reputed institution.
* Additional certification in Treasury, Project Finance, Financial Modelling, or Risk Management will be preferred.

**Experience**

* 15-20+ years of relevant experience in Treasury, Project Finance, Corporate Finance, or Fund Raising.
* Proven experience in large manufacturing, metals, mining, natural resources, infrastructure, power, EPC, or capital-intensive industries.
* Extensive exposure to project funding, structured finance, lender negotiations, and debt management.
* Experience in handling multi-bank arrangements, consortium financing, and large capital expenditure projects.

**Job Description:**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Asset Finance Processor to manage end-to-end asset and equipment finance applications for Australian brokers and clients. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Australian asset finance, loan packaging, credit assessment, lender policies, and broker platforms.

The role requires excellent attention to detail, financial analysis skills, strong stakeholder coordination, and the ability to manage multiple applications within strict timelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Asset Finance Processing**

* Manage asset finance applications from initial submission through approval and settlement.
* Prepare and package accurate and compliant finance applications.
* Review client information, financial documents, and supporting documentation.
* Complete Fact Finds, servicing calculations, pricing comparisons, and application assessments.
* Handle applications for chattel mortgages, novated leases, equipment finance, and commercial finance.
* Research lender policies and identify suitable finance solutions.
* Monitor application progress and ensure timely approvals and settlements.

**Client & Broker Coordination**

* Conduct client interviews and gather required financial information.
* Communicate with clients, brokers, lenders, BDMs, and other stakeholders.
* Follow up on outstanding documents and application requirements.
* Resolve application queries and documentation issues promptly.
* Provide regular updates to brokers and clients regarding application status.

**CRM & Documentation**

* Manage applications through Infynity, Mercury Nexus, AFG, or similar systems.
* Complete BID documentation and maintain compliance records.
* Ensure all application information and supporting documents are accurate and up to date.
* Assist with valuations, reports, scheduling, calls, and other administrative activities.

* Review applications for completeness and accuracy before submission.
* Maintain high documentation and processing standards.
* Identify potential issues and proactively resolve them before they impact approval timelines.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

description:
**About the Company:** 




 Relay Human Cloud is a young \& dynamic company that helps some of the top US\-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting \& Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high\-quality operations in cutting\-edge companies for their entire careers.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 The Lead Controller \- Financial Reporting, Close and Audit will serve as the primary accounting lead for the Company's monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting processes. This individual will coordinate and review the close, prepare consolidated financial information, oversee audit support, and ensure that accounting work is complete, accurate, well documented, and delivered on schedule. The role is hands\-on and requires an experienced accounting professional who can review detailed work, identify unsupported or unusual balances, resolve issues, and communicate clearly with the Chief Financial Officer, accounting personnel, and external auditors. Final accounting judgments, SEC accountability, treasury strategy, tax strategy, and executive\-level communications remain with the Chief Financial Officer.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Financial Close and Consolidation** 




 • Own and administer the monthly, quarterly, and annual close calendar, including deadlines, dependencies, responsibilities, and escalation points.
 



 • Coordinate close activities across the Company's legal entities, business units, and accounting resources.
 



 • Review journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and supporting schedules.
 



 • Ensure all material balance\-sheet accounts are reconciled, supported, and reviewed each reporting period.
 



 • Identify and resolve unexplained balances, aged reconciling items, classification errors, duplicate entries, and other accounting discrepancies.
 



 • Maintain discipline over period close, reopening periods, late entries, and post\-close adjustments.
 



 • Maintain a complete, organized, and audit\-ready electronic close binder.
 



**Financial Reporting** 




 • Prepare and review consolidated balance sheets, statements of operations, statements of cash flows, and related supporting schedules.
 



 • Prepare monthly management reporting packages and clear explanations of material financial\-statement variances.
 



 • Review reported results for unusual trends, period\-over\-period inconsistencies, margin anomalies, and potential accounting errors.
 



 • Maintain the chart of accounts, financial\-statement mapping, consolidation structure, and reporting hierarchy.
 



 • Prepare financial\-statement and footnote support for quarterly and annual SEC filings.
 



 • Perform or coordinate financial\-statement, disclosure, and XBRL tie\-outs and maintain supporting workpapers.
 



**Technical Accounting Support** 




 • Research U.S. GAAP requirements applicable to Company transactions and accounting matters.
 



 • Prepare initial technical accounting analyses and memorandum drafts for Chief Financial Officer review.
 



 • Identify transactions requiring additional accounting analysis, documentation, or external consultation.
 



 • Support accounting for revenue recognition, leases, inventory, stock\-based compensation, discontinued operations, impairments, contingencies, acquisitions, divestitures, and other relevant matters.
 



 • Assist with implementation of new accounting standards and updates to accounting policies.
 



 • Escalate material, unusual, or judgmental accounting matters promptly.
 



**Audit and Quarterly Review Support** 




 • Manage detailed coordination of the annual audit and quarterly review processes.
 



 • Maintain the auditor request list, assign responsibility for requested items, and monitor completion.
 



 • Review schedules and supporting documentation before submission to the external auditors.
 



 • Coordinate responses among accounting personnel, operating teams, and external service providers.
 



 • Track proposed adjustments, passed adjustments, control observations, and unresolved audit matters.
 



 • Identify recurring audit issues and coordinate corrective actions with responsible personnel.
 



 • Escalate potential reporting delays or unresolved audit matters to the Chief Financial Officer.
 



**Internal Controls and Team Coordination** 




 • Maintain financial\-close and financial\-reporting controls, including evidence of preparation and review.
 



 • Maintain accounting policies, close procedures, review checklists, control documentation, and reporting workpapers.
 



 • Identify control failures, documentation deficiencies, and recurring process breakdowns and coordinate remediation.
 



 • Provide day\-to\-day coordination and review of the Accounting Operations Controller and other outsourced accounting resources.
 



 • Maintain an open\-items list covering unresolved accounting, reporting, audit, and control matters.
 



 • Establish clear expectations, review work for quality and completeness, and escalate issues early with recommended solutions.
 



 • Improve documentation and cross\-training to reduce key\-person dependency.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a closely related field.
 



 • CPA, Chartered Accountant, ACCA, or comparable professional accounting designation.
 



 • At least 10 years of progressive accounting and financial\-reporting experience.
 



 • Prior experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, Financial Reporting Director, Audit Manager, or comparable accounting leader.
 



 • Direct experience supporting a U.S. publicly traded company and working within a public\-company reporting calendar.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and experience preparing or reviewing consolidated financial statements.
 



 • Experience with multi\-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany eliminations.
 



 • Experience supporting Forms 10\-Q and 10\-K, including financial\-statement and disclosure support.
 



 • Experience working directly with external auditors in a PCAOB audit environment.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to review reconciliations, identify accounting problems, and drive issues to resolution.
 



 • Strong technical accounting research, written documentation, and English communication skills.
 



 • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency with ERP and financial\-reporting systems.
 



 • Ability to supervise and review the work of remote accounting personnel.
 



 • Ability to provide meaningful recurring work\-hour overlap with U.S. Central Time, with expanded availability during close and reporting periods.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Prior public accounting experience with a national or regional accounting firm.
 



 • Experience in inventory\-intensive distribution, foodservice, retail, e\-commerce, logistics, or a related industry.
 



 • Experience remediating audit findings, significant deficiencies, material weaknesses, or other internal\-control issues.

title: Income Auditor
description:
**Job Role \- Income Auditor (or Revenue Auditor)** 




  





**A specialized financial professional responsible for verifying, monitoring, and auditing all incoming revenue streams within an organization to ensure accuracy, compliance, and control against financial leakage.** 




  





**The role is vital in the hospitality, where revenue originates from multiple point\-of\-sale (POS) terminals, front\-desk transactions, dining outlets, and online booking engines.** 




  





**Core Responsibilities** 




  





**·       Daily Revenue Reconciliation:** 
 Cross\-check daily sales reports, credit card settlements, point\-of\-sale (POS) terminal receipts, and cash deposits against system postings (e.g., Opera PMS, Micros, or custom enterprise software).
 



 ·       
 **Audit of Room Rates \& Allowances:** 
 Verify room rates, package allocations, complimentary services, discounts, and manager allowances against established company approval matrixes and yield management policies.
 



 ·       
 **Cash \& Banking Control:** 
 Reconcile cash collector envelopes, petty cash reimbursements, foreign currency conversions, and daily bank deposits.
 



 ·       
 **Tax Compliance \& Filing:** 
 Audit applicable taxes (such as GST or local occupancy taxes) charged on services to ensure accurate billing and tax ledger posting.
 



 ·  
 **Discrepancy Investigation:** 
 Identify, report, and correct mis\-postings, unexplained overages/shortages, uncollectible city ledger accounts, or unauthorized rate overrides.
 



 ·       
 **Audit Trail Reporting:** 
 Prepare and distribute the Daily Revenue Report (Flash Report) to senior leadership, department heads, and financial controllers.
 



  





**Key Competencies \& Qualifications** 




**\-     Technical Skills** 
 \- Advanced Excel, PMS/POS software proficiency, ERP ledger navigation, revenue reconciliation
 



 \-     
 **Analytical Ability** 




**\-     Local tax regulations** 
 (e.g., GST rates across service tiers), cash\-handling control frameworks
 



  





**Typical Daily Workflow** 




**1\.   Morning Verification: Retrieve night audit reports, daily POS summaries, and payment gateway settlement files from the previous business day.** 




**2\.   Reconciliation \& Matching: Cross\-verify credit card batch settlements against bank deposits and front\-office cashier receipts.** 




**3\.   Allowance \& Rate Audit: Audit all guest folios containing rate adjustments, voids, or complimentary vouchers to confirm authorized signatures.** 




**4\.   Variance Resolution: Flag posting errors to relevant department heads (Front Office, Food \& Beverage, Operations) for corrective entry.** 




**5\.   Daily Reporting: Generate and issue the finalized Daily Income Report for management review.**
